DaggerUncoPoisonU.name: Poisoned Dagger
DaggerUncoPoisonU.desc: The dulled blade of this dagger can still inflict considerable damage.

DaggerCommonPirates.name: Pirate Machete
DaggerCommonPirates.desc: Whether it's clearing brush, cutting meat, or mowing down enemies, a true pirate can always put a machete to good use.

DaggerCommonBelerion.name: Ihrian Khanjar
DaggerCommonBelerion.desc: The curve of its blade brings to mind the ritual daggers carried by Mihrian priests.

DaggerRarePit1.name: Pit Dagger
DaggerRarePit1.desc: A handsome blade offered to participants from the Black Market's equally handsome profits.

DaggerArena.name: Arena Dagger
DaggerArena.desc: Although the hilt is slightly worn, the blade is barely chipped.

WorkmanCookware.name: Cook's Knife
WorkmanCookware.desc: Although the hilt is slightly worn, the blade is barely chipped.

WorkmanSickle.name: Universal Solvent
WorkmanSickle.desc: Of course, this is not a philosopher's stone, but for any alchemist it is a must have thing.

DaggerUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Dagger [L2]
DaggerUncoCraftT1.desc: This dagger has a fearsome blade.

DaggerBUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Dagger [L4]
DaggerBUncoCraftT1.desc: This dagger has a fearsome blade.

DaggerCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Dagger [L6]
DaggerCUncoCraftT1.desc: This dagger has a fearsome blade.

DaggerUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Dagger [L6]
DaggerUncoCraftT2.desc: This weapon exudes an odd and frightening energy.

DaggerBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Dagger [L8]
DaggerBUncoCraftT2.desc: This weapon exudes an odd and frightening energy.

DaggerCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Dagger [L10]
DaggerCUncoCraftT2.desc: This weapon exudes an odd and frightening energy.

DaggerUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Dagger [L12]
DaggerUncoCraftT3.desc: This weapon can slip through weak points in any armour.

DaggerBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Dagger [L14]
DaggerBUncoCraftT3.desc: This weapon can slip through weak points in any armour.

DaggerCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Dagger [L16]
DaggerCUncoCraftT3.desc: This weapon can slip through weak points in any armour.

DaggerRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Dagger(L:15)
DaggerRareCraftT5.desc: Designed to leave your enemies no time to admire it.

DaggerUncoGuard.name: Tactician's Dagger
DaggerUncoGuard.desc: If a weapon could bring luck, this one would.

DaggerUncoInquisition.name: Inquisition Pugio
DaggerUncoInquisition.desc: A sharp weapon, as fearsome as the inquisitors who wield it.

BackAccThiefStealNoPrisoU.name: Inquisition Pugio
BackAccThiefStealNoPrisoU.desc: A sharp weapon, as fearsome as the inquisitors who wield it.

DaggerUncoTrackers.name: Harag Billhook
DaggerUncoTrackers.desc: The longer you look at this billhook, the more it resembles a beast's fang.

DaggerUncoSkelmar.name: Skelmar Knife
DaggerUncoSkelmar.desc: Skelmar knives aren't known for their sturdy construction – it's their versatility that makes them such useful weapons.

DaggerRareOutlaws.name: Ringleader's Dagger
DaggerRareOutlaws.desc: A short blade, practical and sharp. Highly sought after by bandits.

DaggerRareFugitive09.name: The Ogress
DaggerRareFugitive09.desc: The Ogre has often wielded this blade not to kill, but rather to convince many a reluctant parent to sell off their children.

DaggerRareFugitive16.name: Elderguard
DaggerRareFugitive16.desc: This dagger's hilt has proven very useful for smashing enemy heads.

DaggerRareDeserters.name: Looter's Dagger
DaggerRareDeserters.desc: This dagger slit the throats of many innocent villagers.

DaggerRareTraitor.name: Traitor's Blade
DaggerRareTraitor.desc: This blade is proof that the Marheims don't owe their seats in the Broker Council to luck alone.

Viper.name: Viper
Viper.desc: A weapon designed to leave no chance to one's opponent.

VipRR.name: Viper - Billet
VipRR.desc: The workpiece required to craft the special weapon.

DaggerLegendaryBehedite.name: Behedite's Kris
DaggerLegendaryBehedite.desc: The Ancients crafted this weapon as a tribute to Behedite. It was never actually his.

FistLegendaryBehedite.name: Behedite's Katar
FistLegendaryBehedite.desc: The Ancients crafted this weapon as a tribute to Behedite. It was never actually his.

FangsLegendaryBehedite.name: Behedite's Mask
FangsLegendaryBehedite.desc: An unexpected use has been found for the relic of the Ancients. It's time to test it in battle.

DaggerCrook.name: Kruppe's Saex
DaggerCrook.desc: Light and sharp, Kristoff Kruppe's weapon is unmatched when it comes to cutting throats.

DaggerLegendaryArenaIR1.name: Fighter's Cinquedea
DaggerLegendaryArenaIR1.desc: Although the Brotherhood usually disdains daggers, its members like to wield the cinquedea in the arena.

DaggerLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Dagger
DaggerLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: This dagger was originally used for bleeding big game. Its use in combat only dates back to the Edoranian war.

DaggerUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Dagger
DaggerUncoThief.desc: The owner of this discreet and keenly honed little blade probably didn't acquire it by legal means.

MaceStart.name: Old Club
MaceStart.desc: An old club with a split handle.

TheTool.name: The Baton
TheTool.desc: A tool for many purposes in the right hands. The weapon also can be used by mace-bearers.

MaceCommonCivilian.name: Club
MaceCommonCivilian.desc: From table legs to broken branches, resourceful people can use anything as a club.

MaceCommonGuard.name: Bec de Corbin of the Guard
MaceCommonGuard.desc: Very easy to handle, this weapon is very commonly used by members of the Guard.

MaceCommonInquisition.name: Inquisition Flanged Mace
MaceCommonInquisition.desc: This mace strikes fear in fighters’ hearts from Belerion to Alazar.

MaceRarePit1.name: Studded Pit Mace
MaceRarePit1.desc: The incredible weight of this mace is balanced by its impressive efficiency.

MaceArena.name: Arena Spiked Mace
MaceArena.desc: This weapon may lack elegance, but none can withstand it.

MaceUncoAlazar.name: Alazarian Flanged Mace
MaceUncoAlazar.desc: The flanges on this mace call to mind Alazar's jagged mountains.

MaceTorchUncoCraft.name: Combat Torch
MaceTorchUncoCraft.desc: If you know what to do - a torch can serve as a decent weapon.

SwordTorchUncoCraft.name: Combat Torch
SwordTorchUncoCraft.desc: If you know what to do - a torch can serve as a decent weapon.

AxeTorchUncoCraft.name: Combat Torch
AxeTorchUncoCraft.desc: If you know what to do - a torch can serve as a decent weapon.

MaceUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Mace [L2]
MaceUncoCraftT1.desc: While not the most sophisticated of weapons, this studded mace is more than suitable to kill someone.

MaceBUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Mace [L4]
MaceBUncoCraftT1.desc: While not the most sophisticated of weapons, this studded mace is more than suitable to kill someone.

MaceCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Mace [L6]
MaceCUncoCraftT1.desc: While not the most sophisticated of weapons, this studded mace is more than suitable to kill someone.

MaceUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Mace [L6]
MaceUncoCraftT2.desc: The strength of this small and unassuming mace lies in its excellent balance.

MaceBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Mace [L8]
MaceBUncoCraftT2.desc: The strength of this small and unassuming mace lies in its excellent balance.

MaceCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Mace [L10]
MaceCUncoCraftT2.desc: The strength of this small and unassuming mace lies in its excellent balance.

MaceUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Mace [L12]
MaceUncoCraftT3.desc: Nothing can withstand a blow from this morning star. Armour, shields, skulls... It crushes everything with ease.

MaceBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Mace [L14]
MaceBUncoCraftT3.desc: Nothing can withstand a blow from this morning star. Armour, shields, skulls... It crushes everything with ease.

MaceCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Mace [L16]
MaceCUncoCraftT3.desc: Nothing can withstand a blow from this morning star. Armour, shields, skulls... It crushes everything with ease.

MaceRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Morning Star(L:15)
MaceRareCraftT5.desc: This morning star handles as easily as a club for maximum impact.

MaceTwoCommonBandits.name: Rustler's Hammer
MaceTwoCommonBandits.desc: With such a weapon in hands, business always goes well.

MaceUncoBandits.name: Crook's Studded Mace
MaceUncoBandits.desc: The rust on this weapon's spikes makes it even more terrifying.

MaceUncoRoyalKnights.name: Fine Bec de Corbin
MaceUncoRoyalKnights.desc: Countless legends and rumours surround the hand that adorns this Bec de Corbin… presumably all false.

MaceRareDeserters.name: Fugitive's Hammer
MaceRareDeserters.desc: A sturdy hammer featuring a handle adorned with runes.

MaceRareFugitive03.name: Misery
MaceRareFugitive03.desc: Meliance the Traitor has meticulously polished the metal to remove Lord Laheart's crest.

MaceRareFugitive10.name: Purgatory
MaceRareFugitive10.desc: This mace crushed many a skull for the heretic thoughts they contained.

MaceRareFugitive17.name: Basher
MaceRareFugitive17.desc: Despite its simplistic name, this mace is of superb quality and was forged with care.

MaceRareLegion.name: Elite Legion Mace
MaceRareLegion.desc: The Legion started using maces during the Alazarian invasion.

MaceLegendaryErkeshet.name: Erkeshet's Mace
MaceLegendaryErkeshet.desc: No present-day blacksmith could ever hope to reproduce this weapon; the technique used to balance it is only known to the Ancients. And now to the Troop.

MaceLeftHandLegendaryErkeshet.name: Erkeshet's Off-hand Mace
MaceLeftHandLegendaryErkeshet.desc: No present-day blacksmith could ever hope to reproduce this weapon; the technique used to balance it is only known to the Ancients. And now to the Troop.

Mace2HLegendaryErkeshet.name: Erkeshet's Hammer
Mace2HLegendaryErkeshet.desc: No present-day blacksmith could ever hope to reproduce this weapon; the technique used to balance it is only known to the Ancients. And now to the Troop.

MaceLegendaryArena1A1.name: Iceward
MaceLegendaryArena1A1.desc: Made to crush and tear off armour plates, this axe is a dangerous weapon.

AxeLegendaryArenaIR1.name: Gladiators' Menace
AxeLegendaryArenaIR1.desc: This axe is Hiltrerd's personal weapon, and it was with it that she became the Champion.

MaceLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Studded Mace
MaceLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: Maces aren't widely used in Harag, so there's a good chance that whoever designed this weapon was more of a bandit than a hunter.

MaceUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Mace
MaceUncoThief.desc: From the look of this hammer, its owner probably bashes more heads in with it than nails.

Mace2HStart.name: Rusty Two-handed Hammer
Mace2HStart.desc: A massive hammer covered in rust.

Mace2HCommonDeserters.name: Deserters' Two-handed Hammer
Mace2HCommonDeserters.desc: Albeit not very subtle, this two-handed hammer is plenty effective.

Mace2HCommonSkelmar.name: Skelmar Mjöllnir
Mace2HCommonSkelmar.desc: No weapon defines the Skelmar quite like the mjöllnir, a warhammer that is terrifyingly effective against the heavy armour of the Five Kingdoms.

Mace2HRarePit1.name: Large Studded Pit Mace
Mace2HRarePit1.desc: Rumour has it that this mace actually comes from one of the Pit traps. After losing his weapon, a desperate fighter supposedly tore it out of the mechanism.

Mace2HUncoPirates.name: Pirate's Hammer
Mace2HUncoPirates.desc: You can look at the head of this mace from any angle, and it still looks like an Ichtyan face.

GolM.name: Pirate's Hammer
GolM.desc: You can look at the head of this mace from any angle, and it still looks like an Ichtyan face.

Mace2HUncoGuard.name: Hammer of the Guard
Mace2HUncoGuard.desc: While Guard leadership had little taste for this weapon at first, its sheer might gradually won them over.

Mace2HUncoBelerion.name: Ihrian Hammer
Mace2HUncoBelerion.desc: This weapon was designed with only one purpose - to push enemies off the ships.

Mace2HUncoInquisition.name: Inquisition Hammer
Mace2HUncoInquisition.desc: This terrifying weapon has gradually fallen into disuse within the Inquisition, and is now only wielded by certain highly placed individuals.

MaceCommonInquisitioU.name: Inquisition Hammer
MaceCommonInquisitioU.desc: This terrifying weapon has gradually fallen into disuse within the Inquisition, and is now only wielded by certain highly placed individuals.

MaceTwoUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Hammer [L2]
MaceTwoUncoCraftT1.desc: Carrying this hammer is no easy feat, but it is well worth the effort once on the battlefield.

MaceTwoBUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Hammer [L4]
MaceTwoBUncoCraftT1.desc: Carrying this hammer is no easy feat, but it is well worth the effort once on the battlefield.

MaceTwoCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Hammer [L6]
MaceTwoCUncoCraftT1.desc: Carrying this hammer is no easy feat, but it is well worth the effort once on the battlefield.

MaceTwoUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Hammer [L6]
MaceTwoUncoCraftT2.desc: The spectral leather ensures a perfect grip... almost too perfect.

MaceTwoBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Hammer [L8]
MaceTwoBUncoCraftT2.desc: The spectral leather ensures a perfect grip... almost too perfect.

MaceTwoCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Hammer [L10]
MaceTwoCUncoCraftT2.desc: The spectral leather ensures a perfect grip... almost too perfect.

MaceTwoUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Hammer [L12]
MaceTwoUncoCraftT3.desc: Heavy but extremely sturdy, this hammer is known to wreak havoc on the battlefield.

MaceTwoBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Hammer [L14]
MaceTwoBUncoCraftT3.desc: Heavy but extremely sturdy, this hammer is known to wreak havoc on the battlefield.

MaceTwoCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Hammer [L16]
MaceTwoCUncoCraftT3.desc: Heavy but extremely sturdy, this hammer is known to wreak havoc on the battlefield.

Mace2HRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Two-Handed Morning Star(L:15)
Mace2HRareCraftT5.desc: At the end of the fight, the head of this morning star should be as red as the vairmeil of its handle.

Mace2HRareCompanions.name: Warlords' Hammer
Mace2HRareCompanions.desc: The mere sight of this mace is enough to make smugglers break out in a cold sweat. So say the Mercenaries of the Brotherhood, at least.

Mace2HRareAlazar.name: Colossal Flanged Mace
Mace2HRareAlazar.desc: The Colossi of the Alazarian army are so named because they wield this impressive flanged mace.

Mace2HRareFugitive01.name: Rogue
Mace2HRareFugitive01.desc: Rojen used this mace to murder in their sleep the merchants he was meant to protect.

Mace2HRareFugitive15.name: Hope-Slayer
Mace2HRareFugitive15.desc: The shadow cast by this mace still haunts the residents of Harag.

Mace2HRareRoyalKnights.name: Gallant Knight's Large Flanged Mace
Mace2HRareRoyalKnights.desc: What assassin would be foolish enough to attack the King of Alazar when his Knights are armed with maces like these?

Mace2HLegendaryColonel.name: Colonel's Hammer
Mace2HLegendaryColonel.desc: With the strategic changes initiated within the Legion by General Edor, the hammer became obsolete. The rare models still in use today were forged in the time of Jeru's Empire.

Mace2HLegendaryInquisition1.name: High Inquisitor's Hammer
Mace2HLegendaryInquisition1.desc: While High Inquisitors are free to choose their preferred weapon, you'll often see a hammer near the flaming pyres of justice.

Lucilla.name: Lucilla
Lucilla.desc: A two-handed morning star with a handle wrapped in human skin. Who did it belong to?

Mace2HInsect.name: Bog Thunder
Mace2HInsect.desc: Sensible travellers will overlook how ridiculous the Bog Thunder is and hold on to it for being remarkably effective against cardinal mosquitoes.

Mace2HLegendaryDagan.name: Dagan's Hammer
Mace2HLegendaryDagan.desc: This hammer's embellishments leave characteristic impressions on its victims' flesh. A peculiar way of decorating the battlefield...

MaceLegendaryDagan.name: Dagan's Mace
MaceLegendaryDagan.desc: This mace's embellishments leave characteristic impressions on its victims' flesh. A peculiar way of decorating the battlefield...

AnimalLegendaryDagan.name: Dagan's Cape
AnimalLegendaryDagan.desc: An unexpected use has been found for the relic of the Ancients. It's time to test it in battle.

Mace2HLegendaryArenaIR1.name: Fighter's Two-Handed Mace
Mace2HLegendaryArenaIR1.desc: Sergeant Ada is famous for wielding this awe-inspiring mace.

Mace2HLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Large Studded Mace
Mace2HLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: One of the most popular children's songs in Harag recounts how a druid named Segune decided to go rabbit hunting with a big mace. The chorus is famously hilarious.

Mace2HLegendaryChampion22.name: Macabre
Mace2HLegendaryChampion22.desc: Whatever this weapon's original name was, none could suit it better now.

Mace2HLegendaryE3Tavern.name: Broom
Mace2HLegendaryE3Tavern.desc: People often forget about improvised weapons, just as they scorn those who use them... and yet! How many intruders, bandits and other vermin have been driven off with a firm swing of the broom?

Mace2HUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Hammer
Mace2HUncoThief.desc: With this large mace, its owner can demolish anything that stands between them and their loot – whether it's a lock, a door, or some unfortunate guard's armour.

AxeStart.name: Rusty Felling Axe
AxeStart.desc: This axe has been eaten away by rust.

CaptainHorn.name: Captain's Bugle
CaptainHorn.desc: The only valuable item saved from the good old days. This weapon also can be used by dagger-bearers.

AxeCommonDeserters.name: Chipped Axe
AxeCommonDeserters.desc: This axe was designed to chop wood, but it is used for something a little different now.

WorkmanMinerware.name: Pickaxe
WorkmanMinerware.desc: The main tool for mining, reliable and sturdy.

AxeCommonTrackers.name: Trackers' Axe
AxeCommonTrackers.desc: The intricate patterns on the blade are meant to repel the Ghost Pack.

AxeCommonSkelmar.name: Skelmar Axe
AxeCommonSkelmar.desc: The axe is a big part of Skelmar culture. It's the first weapon that young warriors learn to handle, and the emblem of numerous tribes.

AxeRarePit1.name: Pit Cleaver
AxeRarePit1.desc: This weapon is very popular in the Black Market Pit, and guarantees a rousing show every time.

AxeUncoPirates.name: Pirate's Axe
AxeUncoPirates.desc: This axe has a razor-sharp blade.

AxeRareBelerion.name: Ihrian Bardiche
AxeRareBelerion.desc: Forged from Akhedian steel, this small axe is decorated with Hessura's symbol.

AxeUncoTrackers.name: Hunter's Axe
AxeUncoTrackers.desc: This axe is adorned with every last feather of a marshland tit.

AxeUncoInquisition.name: Inquisition Axe
AxeUncoInquisition.desc: Considered barbaric and too similar to the Trackers’ weapons, this axe is rarely used within the Inquisition.

AxeArena.name: Arena Axe
AxeArena.desc: Small scratches indicate that this axe has been sharpened more than necessary.

AxeUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Axe [L2]
AxeUncoCraftT1.desc: The haft of this axe is covered in thick leather, allowing for a better grip on the weapon.

AxeBUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Axe [L4]
AxeBUncoCraftT1.desc: The haft of this axe is covered in thick leather, allowing for a better grip on the weapon.

AxeCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Axe [L6]
AxeCUncoCraftT1.desc: The haft of this axe is covered in thick leather, allowing for a better grip on the weapon.

AxeUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Axe [L6]
AxeUncoCraftT2.desc: Trackers say that these axes recognise the blacksmith who forged them as their only master.

AxeBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Axe [L8]
AxeBUncoCraftT2.desc: Trackers say that these axes recognise the blacksmith who forged them as their only master.

AxeCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Axe [L10]
AxeCUncoCraftT2.desc: Trackers say that these axes recognise the blacksmith who forged them as their only master.

AxeUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Axe [L12]
AxeUncoCraftT3.desc: It takes such skill to craft this axe that successfully forging one is enough to make a blacksmith rich.

AxeBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Axe [L14]
AxeBUncoCraftT3.desc: It takes such skill to craft this axe that successfully forging one is enough to make a blacksmith rich.

AxeCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Axe [L16]
AxeCUncoCraftT3.desc: It takes such skill to craft this axe that successfully forging one is enough to make a blacksmith rich.

AxeRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Axe(L:15)
AxeRareCraftT5.desc: The decorative motif on the head of this axe is a three-leaf clover. A fourth would have completely thrown off the weapon’s balance.

AxeRareFugitive07.name: Joras
AxeRareFugitive07.desc: Judging by the name carved on this axe's handle, Joras was probably the weapon's owner before it came into Bartes' possession.

AxeRareFugitive18.name: Traitor's Axe
AxeRareFugitive18.desc: Using the Krowns stolen from the Ludern Guard, Maudeg has improved this axe whilst on the run.

AxeRareCompanion.name: Peacebearer's Axe
AxeRareCompanion.desc: It is said that peacebearers were given their name because of their distinctive axes, the mere sight of which is enough to appease tensions.

AxeLegendaryHarag.name: Devotion
AxeLegendaryHarag.desc: For nearly 20 years, Bionn has firmly gripped the handle of this axe.

AxeLegendaryArena2G2.name: Victorious
AxeLegendaryArena2G2.desc: Trivetta Raniel has diligently marked every Arena Clash she's won using Victorious on the weapon's handle.

AxeLegendaryArenaG.name: Victorious
AxeLegendaryArenaG.desc: Trivetta Raniel has diligently marked every Arena Clash she's won using Victorious on the weapon's handle.

AxeLegendaryArena2GR.name: Victorious - Billet
AxeLegendaryArena2GR.desc: The workpiece required to craft the special weapon.

AxeLegendaryNepti.name: Nepti’s Axe
AxeLegendaryNepti.desc: The engravings on this axe are so fine and delicate that it looks more like a ceremonial weapon than a deadly tool.

Axe2HLegendaryNepti.name: Nepti’s Poleaxe
Axe2HLegendaryNepti.desc: The engravings on this axe are so fine and delicate that it looks more like a ceremonial weapon than a deadly tool.

ShieldLegendaryNepti.name: Nepti’s Shield
ShieldLegendaryNepti.desc: The engravings on this shield are so fine and delicate that it looks more like a ceremonial weapon than a deadly tool.

AxeLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Axe
AxeLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: The hide that covers the shaft of this axe is always dyed black, in honour of friends lost to the Hunt for the Beast.

AxeUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Axe
AxeUncoThief.desc: Stolen from a skilled craftsman, this axe is now used to criminal ends.

Axe2HStart.name: Old Poleaxe
Axe2HStart.desc: An old axe with a partly mouldy handle that seems to be crumbling away.

Axe2HCommonCompanions.name: Brotherhood's Poleaxe
Axe2HCommonCompanions.desc: This axe was recently adopted by the Brotherhood under the influence of Belerion.

Axe2HCommonPirates.name: Pirates' Poleaxe
Axe2HCommonPirates.desc: Axes are the main tool for repairing a ship. Or boarding one.

Axe2HCommonTrackers.name: Trackers' Great Axe
Axe2HCommonTrackers.desc: This axe is imbued with three animal spirits: marshland tit feathers, a crocswine fang, and the fur of a Ghost Pack monster.

Axe2HRarePit1.name: Pit Great Axe
Axe2HRarePit1.desc: Black Market rules state that the blade of this great axe must be dulled. But no one has really taken the time to check.

AxeTwoUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Poleaxe [L2]
AxeTwoUncoCraftT1.desc: The blacksmith's signature can be seen on the haft.

AxeTwoBUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Poleaxe [L4]
AxeTwoBUncoCraftT1.desc: The blacksmith's signature can be seen on the haft.

AxeTwoCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Poleaxe [L6]
AxeTwoCUncoCraftT1.desc: The blacksmith's signature can be seen on the haft.

AxeTwoUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Poleaxe [L6]
AxeTwoUncoCraftT2.desc: Thanks to its long reach, the wielder of this poleaxe can fight several opponents head-on.

AxeTwoBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Poleaxe [L8]
AxeTwoBUncoCraftT2.desc: Thanks to its long reach, the wielder of this poleaxe can fight several opponents head-on.

AxeTwoCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Poleaxe [L10]
AxeTwoCUncoCraftT2.desc: Thanks to its long reach, the wielder of this poleaxe can fight several opponents head-on.

Axe2HCommonAlazar.name: Alazarian Poleaxe
Axe2HCommonAlazar.desc: Forging this axe requires strict observance of iron and rimesteel proportions.

AxeTwoUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Poleaxe [L12]
AxeTwoUncoCraftT3.desc: According to Akhed tradition, the engravings adorning this axe's blade should be highly respected.

AxeTwoBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Poleaxe [L14]
AxeTwoBUncoCraftT3.desc: According to Akhed tradition, the engravings adorning this axe's blade should be highly respected.

AxeTwoCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Poleaxe [L16]
AxeTwoCUncoCraftT3.desc: According to Akhed tradition, the engravings adorning this axe's blade should be highly respected.

Axe2HRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Great Axe(L:15)
Axe2HRareCraftT5.desc: This great axe would have been utterly ordinary without the perfect balance provided by the vairmeil on its handle.

HonorAxe.name: Honoured Poleaxe
HonorAxe.desc: One of the mercenaries' clients was an alchemist, and as a reward, he refined this poleaxe, adding unique properties to it.

Axe2HUncoOutlaws.name: Great Pig Iron
Axe2HUncoOutlaws.desc: Favourite of bandits and marauders alike, the Great Pig Iron is synonymous with prestige among outlaws.

Axe2HUncoOutlawU.name: Great Pig Iron
Axe2HUncoOutlawU.desc: Favourite of bandits and marauders alike, the Great Pig Iron is synonymous with prestige among outlaws.

Axe2HUncoInquisition.name: Two-handed Axe of the Eye
Axe2HUncoInquisition.desc: Equally fearsome when beheading miscreants or building a pyre, this axe is very popular in the Inquisition.

Axe2HUncoRoyalKnights.name: Large Fine Double-Edged Axe
Axe2HUncoRoyalKnights.desc: Though abandoned centuries ago in all the other kingdoms, double-edged axes are back with a vengeance in Alazar.

Axe2HRareFugitive08.name: Mutiny
Axe2HRareFugitive08.desc: Mutiny is an axe that seems much more balanced than its previous owner.

Axe2HRareFugitive11.name: (mis)Judgement
Axe2HRareFugitive11.desc: Without a doubt, the ideal tool for quick and effective (in)Justice.

Axe2HRareSkelmar.name: Haersir's Two-handed Axe
Axe2HRareSkelmar.desc: The Haersirs spread terror in Ormance County by splitting Guards' and Legionaries' armour with their fearsome two-handed axes.

Splitter.name: Splitter
Splitter.desc: Alexa was deeply affected by the war. So, when she forged Splitter, she swore to only ever use it for chopping wood. A few days later, she beheaded a lord of Alazar.

Axe2HLegendaryChampion19.name: Yrsa
Axe2HLegendaryChampion19.desc: The name Yrsa is engraved on one face of the axe. There's no way of knowing if it's the name of the weapon, the blacksmith who forged it, or someone Kraven cares for.

Axe2HLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Great Axe
Axe2HLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: The symbol on this great axe represents the Beast. It smashes armour and shatters skulls as effectively as the Beast itself.

Axe2HLegendaryLegion.name: Triumph
Axe2HLegendaryLegion.desc: This axe was a gift to Colonel Marcus from his mother on his fifty-sixth birthday, and he wouldn't part with this beloved weapon for anything in the world.

Axe2HLegendaryInquisition.name: Virtue
Axe2HLegendaryInquisition.desc: Wielded by Inquisitor Daphne, this axe is well-known to heretics and pagans throughout the land. Its edge is said to be remarkably keen, able to amputate or decapitate with a single swing.

Axe2HUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Poleaxe
Axe2HUncoThief.desc: Whoever carries this axe is well-equipped to cut their enemies down to size.

Axe2HLegendaryEnlil.name: Enlil's Poleaxe
Axe2HLegendaryEnlil.desc: The most versatile weapon a sailor could ask for. Its relentlessly sharp blade can cut through enemies, rigging, and hulls with equal ease.

AxeLegendaryEnlil.name: Enlil's Axe
AxeLegendaryEnlil.desc: The most versatile weapon a sailor could ask for. Its relentlessly sharp blade can cut through enemies, rigging, and hulls with equal ease.

ClawsLegendaryEnlil.name: Enlil's Thorns
ClawsLegendaryEnlil.desc: An unexpected use has been found for the relic of the Ancients. It's time to test it in battle.

SwordStart.name: Rusty Gladius
SwordStart.desc: An old gladius that once belonged to a soldier.

SwordCommonAlazar.name: Alazarian Straight Sword
SwordCommonAlazar.desc: This weapon is the epitome of Alazarian sobriety.

SwordCommonLegion.name: Legionary's Gladius
SwordCommonLegion.desc: This gladius isn't much to look at, but its owner received it as a gift from the Kingdom of Edoran.

SwordRarePit1.name: Pit Straight Sword
SwordRarePit1.desc: The coat of arms of this sword's previous owner has been artfully concealed with the colours of the Black Market.

SwordCommonLegioU.name: Legionary's Gladius
SwordCommonLegioU.desc: This gladius isn't much to look at, but its owner received it as a gift from the Kingdom of Edoran.

SwordRarePirates.name: Privateer's Boarding Cutlass
SwordRarePirates.desc: Pirate weaponry at its most iconic.

SwordCommonLuth.name: Lute
SwordCommonLuth.desc: A beautiful instrument that can also serve as a makeshift weapon in a brawl.

SwordUncoCompanion.name: Brotherhood's Sword
SwordUncoCompanion.desc: One needs just glance at the many decorations on the hilt and blade to know this sword belongs to the Brotherhood.

SwordUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Sword [L2]
SwordUncoCraftT1.desc: This sword is light and very sharp, but not terribly sturdy.

SwordBUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Sword [L4]
SwordBUncoCraftT1.desc: This sword is light and very sharp, but not terribly sturdy.

SwordCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Sword [L6]
SwordCUncoCraftT1.desc: This sword is light and very sharp, but not terribly sturdy.

SwordUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Sword [L6]
SwordUncoCraftT2.desc: The pallidity of the spectral leather seems to have bled onto the blade.

SwordBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Sword [L8]
SwordBUncoCraftT2.desc: The pallidity of the spectral leather seems to have bled onto the blade.

SwordCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Sword [L10]
SwordCUncoCraftT2.desc: The pallidity of the spectral leather seems to have bled onto the blade.

SwordUncoRareT3.name: Rimesteel Sword
SwordUncoRareT3.desc: Rimesteel is so strong that swords like this can be passed down from generation to generation.

SwordUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Sword [L12]
SwordUncoCraftT3.desc: This weapon is so imposing and beautiful that it could belong to the General himself.

SwordBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Sword [L14]
SwordBUncoCraftT3.desc: This weapon is so imposing and beautiful that it could belong to the General himself.

SwordCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Sword [L16]
SwordCUncoCraftT3.desc: This weapon is so imposing and beautiful that it could belong to the General himself.

SwordRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Straight Sword(L:15)
SwordRareCraftT5.desc: No matter how many owners it’s had, the vairmeil on its guard will never tarnish.

SwordRareInquisition.name: Gladius of the Eye
SwordRareInquisition.desc: The Eye on the pommel of this gladius induces an irresistible urge to burn heretics.

SwordRareInquisitionUp.name: Sword of the Paladin
SwordRareInquisitionUp.desc: One of the best weapons Edoran can offer - only the chosen of the Inquisition are allowed to wield it.

SwordRareFugitive02.name: Fervour
SwordRareFugitive02.desc: Sylla wielded this Ulfberht to slay innocents and heretics alike in the name of the All-seeing Eye.

SwordRareFugitive19.name: Strongblade
SwordRareFugitive19.desc: Passed from one owner to the next following some barbaric rule, this gladius is shrouded in mystery.

SwordRareGuard.name: Defender's Falchion
SwordRareGuard.desc: An easy-to-use weapon that any blacksmiths in the Five Kingdoms could forge with their eyes closed.

SwordRareSkelmar.name: Ulfark's Ulfberht
SwordRareSkelmar.desc: Well-balanced and easy to handle, the ulfberht is also an expensive and complicated weapon to forge. Only the richest of the Skelmar can afford one.

SwordLegendaryMehyt.name: Mehyt's Sword
SwordLegendaryMehyt.desc: Forged from an immutable metal by the Ancients, this sword has vanquished time itself.

Sword2HLegendaryMehyt.name: Mehyt's Greatsword
Sword2HLegendaryMehyt.desc: Forged from an immutable metal by the Ancients, this sword has vanquished time itself.

ShieldLegendaryMehyt.name: Mehyt's Shield
ShieldLegendaryMehyt.desc: Forged from an immutable metal by the Ancients, this shield has vanquished time itself.

SwordLegendaryArena1G2.name: Glory
SwordLegendaryArena1G2.desc: Intended to guarantee its wielder's victory, this weapon still failed Toro, champion of Bernna's arena.

SwordLegendaryArenaG.name: Glory
SwordLegendaryArenaG.desc: Intended to guarantee its wielder's victory, this weapon still failed Toro, champion of Bernna's arena.

SwordLegendaryArena1GR.name: Glory - Billet
SwordLegendaryArena1GR.desc: The workpiece required to craft the special weapon.

SwordLegendaryEvoland.name: Clink's Sword
SwordLegendaryEvoland.desc: It appears this sword was forged very far from the Five Kingdoms.

SwordLegendaryChampion11.name: Maelstrom
SwordLegendaryChampion11.desc: This sword was forged for someone of noble lineage. If it found its way into Eokeld's hands, its original owner has likely returned to the Light.

SwordLegendarySealord.name: Groac'h
SwordLegendarySealord.desc: According to Ganne, this boarding cutlass was crafted by Tules.

SwordLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Falchion
SwordLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: Less versatile than an axe, this falchion is generally left to the biggest show-off in the hunting party.

SwordLegendaryEdor.name: General Edor's Sword
SwordLegendaryEdor.desc:
It was with this blade that General Edor once overthrew the Empire of Jeru, conquered the Northern Kingdom, and liberated Gosenberg from Alazar's yoke.
Or it could be a very convincing replica.

SwordUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Sword
SwordUncoThief.desc: A nameless sword that's far too well-made to have been forged by criminals.

Sword2HStart.name: Old Longsword
Sword2HStart.desc: A sword with a long but damaged blade.

Sword2HCommonCompanions.name: Brotherhood's Greatsword
Sword2HCommonCompanions.desc: The welts on the blade indicate that this weapon has seen many battles.

Sword2HCommonInquisition.name: Inquisition Spatha
Sword2HCommonInquisition.desc: This spatha is one of the Inquisition's most iconic weapons.

Sword2HCommonRoyalKnights.name: Knight's Flamberge
Sword2HCommonRoyalKnights.desc: This sword would be much less impressive with a straight blade.

Sword2HRarePit1.name: Pit Longsword
Sword2HRarePit1.desc: Taking a bit more damage with every fight, this sword will likely end up breaking at the worst possible moment.

Sword2HUncoBelerion.name: Ihrian Great Shamshir
Sword2HUncoBelerion.desc: Difficult to wield because of its curved blade, the great shamshir was long reserved to Ihraa's finest swordsmen.

Sword2HUncoPirates.name: Ihrian Scimitar
Sword2HUncoPirates.desc: Difficult to wield because of its large blade, the weapon can be used by few among the pirates.

Sword2HUncoBelerioU.name: Ihrian Great Shamshir
Sword2HUncoBelerioU.desc: Difficult to wield because of its curved blade, the great shamshir was long reserved to Ihraa's finest swordsmen.

Sword2HArena.name: Arena Great Falchion
Sword2HArena.desc: Its owner was a famous gladiator who likely fell as the crowd cheered on.

SwordTwoUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Greatsword [L2]
SwordTwoUncoCraftT1.desc: This greatsword may not be sharp enough to behead an opponent, but it will definitely break their neck.

SwordTwoBUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Greatsword [L4]
SwordTwoBUncoCraftT1.desc: This greatsword may not be sharp enough to behead an opponent, but it will definitely break their neck.

SwordTwoCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Greatsword [L6]
SwordTwoCUncoCraftT1.desc: This greatsword may not be sharp enough to behead an opponent, but it will definitely break their neck.

SwordTwoUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Greatsword [L6]
SwordTwoUncoCraftT2.desc: This greatsword gives off a unique and somewhat frightening aura that often makes its owner put it away before sleeping.

SwordTwoBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Greatsword [L8]
SwordTwoBUncoCraftT2.desc: This greatsword gives off a unique and somewhat frightening aura that often makes its owner put it away before sleeping.

SwordTwoCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Greatsword [L10]
SwordTwoCUncoCraftT2.desc: This greatsword gives off a unique and somewhat frightening aura that often makes its owner put it away before sleeping.

Sword2HUncoLegion.name: Legionary's Spatha
Sword2HUncoLegion.desc: The hilt of this weapon was repaired several times. Its blade, however, does not have the slightest dent.

Sword2HUncoLegionUp.name: Legionary's Spatha
Sword2HUncoLegionUp.desc: The hilt of this weapon was repaired several times. Its blade, however, does not have the slightest dent.

Sword2HRareAlazar.name: Brigadier's Flamberge
Sword2HRareAlazar.desc: The flamberge used by the royal army owes its appearance to the great master painter Sigurd Adr Alazar.

Sword2HRareAlazarUp.name: Brigadier's Flamberge
Sword2HRareAlazarUp.desc: The flamberge used by the royal army owes its appearance to the great master painter Sigurd Adr Alazar.

SwordTwoUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Greatsword [L12]
SwordTwoUncoCraftT3.desc: Wielding this weapon takes as much skill as forging it.

SwordTwoBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Greatsword [L14]
SwordTwoBUncoCraftT3.desc: Wielding this weapon takes as much skill as forging it.

SwordTwoCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Greatsword [L16]
SwordTwoCUncoCraftT3.desc: Wielding this weapon takes as much skill as forging it.

Sword2HRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Claymore(L:15)
Sword2HRareCraftT5.desc: A claymore of this quality needs no embellishments.

Sword2HRareFugitive05.name: Fredegund
Sword2HRareFugitive05.desc: No one knows how this sword got its name... Perhaps it is a tribute to someone the Old Crone deeply cherished?

Sword2HRareFugitive13.name: Claret
Sword2HRareFugitive13.desc: The weapon's handle still gives off the aroma of cheap wine.

Sword2HRareOutlaws.name: Criminal's Claymore
Sword2HRareOutlaws.desc: Bandits use this sword as a mace when it gets dull.

Sword2HLegendaryArena1G2.name: Prosperity
Sword2HLegendaryArena1G2.desc: Though his favourite weapon never produced what its name implied, Kogo refused to part with it.

Sword2HLegendaryArenaG.name: Prosperity
Sword2HLegendaryArenaG.desc: Though his favourite weapon never produced what its name implied, Kogo refused to part with it.

Sword2HLegendaryArena1GR.name: Prosperity - Billet
Sword2HLegendaryArena1GR.desc: The workpiece required to craft the special weapon.

Sword2HLegendaryArenaIR1.name: Fighter's Greatsword
Sword2HLegendaryArenaIR1.desc: Duller than other blades the Brotherhood wields, Lieutenant Loderans' weapon is no less deadly.

Sword2HLegendaryChampion20.name: Despair
Sword2HLegendaryChampion20.desc: As though its appearance alone weren't enough to strike fear into his enemies' hearts, High Jarl Sven named his favourite sword Despair.

Sword2HLegendaryRuinIR2.name: Urashu Great Kopis
Sword2HLegendaryRuinIR2.desc: Strange marks on the flat of this kopis suggest that someone tried to break it. Fortunately, the high quality of its metal stopped them from succeeding.

Sword2HLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Great Falchion
Sword2HLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: The pommel of this great falchion imitates the jaws of the Beast, recognisable by its flat teeth.

Sword2HUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Greatsword
Sword2HUncoThief.desc: This weapon holds no poetry for craftsmen. For killers, on the other hand...

PolearmStart.name: Farmer's Pitchfork
PolearmStart.desc: A pitchfork used to turn soil and stir up rebellion.

SpearStart.name: Homemade Spear
SpearStart.desc: A weapons made from the scrap materials.

PolearmCommonCivilian.name: Rancher's Pitchfork
PolearmCommonCivilian.desc: A pitchfork that seems to have been used to chase away a few yokels.

PolearmCommonGuard.name: Watcher's Spear
PolearmCommonGuard.desc: An unremarkable spear that was improved using whatever its owner had at hand.

PolearmCommonBelerion.name: Ihrian Polearm
PolearmCommonBelerion.desc: The shaft of this polearm features the intermingled colours of Mihr and Hessura.

PolearmRarePit1.name: Pit Pike
PolearmRarePit1.desc: In his youth, the Baron fought with a spear very similar to this one.

PolearmCommonBelerioU.name: Ihrian Polearm
PolearmCommonBelerioU.desc: The shaft of this polearm features the intermingled colours of Mihr and Hessura.

PolearmArena.name: Arena Polearm
PolearmArena.desc: The wood has absorbed too much sweat and blood to retain its original colour.

PolearmUncoAlazar.name: Alazarian Polearm
PolearmUncoAlazar.desc: A scholar and a blacksmith worked closely together to create this weapon.

PolearmUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Polearm [L2]
PolearmUncoCraftT1.desc: The blacksmith who created such a weapon must have been very cross with someone.

PolearmBUncoCraftT1.desc: The blacksmith who created such a weapon must have been very cross with someone.

SpearCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Spear [L6]
SpearCUncoCraftT1.desc: The blacksmith who created such a weapon must have been very cross with someone.

PolearmUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Polearm [L6]
PolearmUncoCraftT2.desc: Made with spectral leather, this polearm boasts both reach and sturdiness.

PolearmBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Polearm [L8]
PolearmBUncoCraftT2.desc: Made with spectral leather, this polearm boasts both reach and sturdiness.

SpearCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Spear [L10]
SpearCUncoCraftT2.desc: Made with spectral leather, this polearm boasts both reach and sturdiness.

PolearmUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Polearm [L12]
PolearmUncoCraftT3.desc: The appearance of this polearm hasn't changed much since it was brought to the Five Kingdoms from Akhed.

PolearmBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Polearm [L14]
PolearmBUncoCraftT3.desc: The appearance of this polearm hasn't changed much since it was brought to the Five Kingdoms from Akhed.

SpearUncoCraftT3.desc: The appearance of this spear hasn't changed much since it was brought to the Five Kingdoms from Akhed.

SpearCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Spear [L16]
SpearCUncoCraftT3.desc: The appearance of this spear hasn't changed much since it was brought to the Five Kingdoms from Akhed.

PolearmRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Partisan(L:15)
PolearmRareCraftT5.desc: The handle of this partisan can be carved from any variety of wood, as long as it’s reinforced with vairmeil.

PolearmUncoDeserters.name: Deserters' Lance
PolearmUncoDeserters.desc: This lance was once part of a foot soldier's kit, but years of outdoor use have greatly changed it.

PolearmUncoLegion.name: Danae's Mace
PolearmUncoLegion.desc: She left the weapon and her service to the Legion with no regrets.

MaceUncoLegion.name: Legion Mace
MaceUncoLegion.desc: Simply touching this weapon's shaft makes you want to invade Harag.

PolearmUncoInquisition.name: Inquisition Pilum
PolearmUncoInquisition.desc: The pilum had its glory days under the Empire of Jeru, but was later replaced with other weapons considered to be more modern.

AnimAccSecondLifU.name: Inquisition Pilum
AnimAccSecondLifU.desc: The pilum had its glory days under the Empire of Jeru, but was later replaced with other weapons considered to be more modern.

PolearmRareLegion.name: Officer's Pilum
PolearmRareLegion.desc: Legion officers' pilums can be recognised by their sturdiness and intricate details, but also because their owner's name is engraved on the shaft.

PolearmRareLegioU.name: Officer's Pilum
PolearmRareLegioU.desc: Legion officers' pilums can be recognised by their sturdiness and intricate details, but also because their owner's name is engraved on the shaft.

PolearmRareFugitive04.name: Corseque of Remembrance
PolearmRareFugitive04.desc: Obsessed with Edoran's glorious past, Captain Gacius had a corseque forged from an ancient model.

PolearmRareFugitive14.name: Crocsting
PolearmRareFugitive14.desc: Engraved on the tip of this halberd, the silhouette of a massive crocswine is revealed in all its fearsome beauty when dipped in blood.

PolearmRareTrackers.name: Pursuer's Pike
PolearmRareTrackers.desc: Light armour doesn't stand a chance against this pike, that was made to pierce Ghost Pack hides.

PolearmRareRoyalKnights.name: Gentleman's Partisan
PolearmRareRoyalKnights.desc: Alazarian gentlemen find countless creative and tasteful ways to personalise their partisans.

PolearmLegendaryHoroun.name: Horoun's Partisan
PolearmLegendaryHoroun.desc: It is impossible to identify what this partisan is made of. After a few battles, you realise it is indestructible.

SpearLegendaryHoroun.name: Horoun's Spear
SpearLegendaryHoroun.desc: It is impossible to identify what this spear is made of. After a few battles, you realise it is indestructible.

PolearmLegendaryGrinmeer.name: Liberator
PolearmLegendaryGrinmeer.desc: This halberd was meant for a Grinmeer Guard, but for some reason, Fenris has removed all the leather from it.

BowLegendaryEye.name: Bow of the Ancients
BowLegendaryEye.desc: This weapon belonged to the Ancients of the Celestium, and the power of the Eye itself was embedded in this weapon.

PolearmLegendaryEye.name: Polearm of the Ancients
PolearmLegendaryEye.desc: This weapon belonged to the Ancients of the Celestium, and the power of the Eye itself was embedded in this weapon.

Sword2HLegendaryEye.name: Greatsword of the Ancients
Sword2HLegendaryEye.desc: This weapon belonged to the Ancients of the Celestium, and the power of the Eye itself was embedded in this weapon.

PolearmLegendaryBelerion.name: Belerion's Spear
PolearmLegendaryBelerion.desc: Rumour has it this spear belonged to Belerion Halios, but it looks to be much older than the legend.

PolearmLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Hunting Spear
PolearmLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: This weapon is difficult to handle: at any moment, the lancer's hands could slip on the shaft and come into contact with the bare bone of the Beast.

PolearmLegendaryChampion23.name: Sovereign
PolearmLegendaryChampion23.desc: Wielded by Adelbarth in Edoran's war with the Northern Kingdom, Sovereign is one of the most legendary weapons in the history of the Alazar line.

PolearmUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Polearm
PolearmUncoThief.desc: This spear has been used in countless acts of intimidation, thievery and murder.

AncientSpear1.name: Spear of the Ancient Soldier
AncientSpear1.desc: This spear was created based on schematics of the one that belonged to Belerion Halios.

AncientSpear2.name: Spear of the Ancient Soldier
AncientSpear2.desc: This spear was created based on schematics of the one that belonged to Belerion Halios.

AncientSpear3.name: Spear of the Ancient Soldier
AncientSpear3.desc: This spear was created based on schematics of the one that belonged to Belerion Halios.

BowStart.name: Improvised Bow
BowStart.desc: The strange curvature of this bow betrays the fact that it was not designed by a master fletcher.

BowCommonAlazar.name: Alazarian Bow
BowCommonAlazar.desc: The wood is barely visible under the rimesteel reinforcements.

BowCommonOutlaws.name: Refugee's Bow
BowCommonOutlaws.desc: The handmade small bow - but does the job right.

BowCommonOutlaws1.name: Poacher's Bow
BowCommonOutlaws1.desc: This bow is small enough for its wielder to run away unencumbered.

BowCommonLegion.name: Legion Bow
BowCommonLegion.desc: Easy to make and repair, this short bow is ideal for equipping the Legion's many archers.

BowRarePit.name: Pit Bow
BowRarePit.desc: Despite a coat or two of rather convincing silver paint, this bow is made of ordinary wood.

BowRarePirates.name: Pirate's Bow
BowRarePirates.desc: This short bow has limited range, but it is more than sufficient when boarding an enemy ship.

BowRareBelerion.name: Ihrian Bow
BowRareBelerion.desc: Using a bow at sea is far from easy, but the Ihrians haven't given up on this weapon.

BowArena.name: Arena Bow
BowArena.desc: This bow lacks range, as if it were made to be used indoors.

BowUncoDeserters.name: Fugitive's Bow
BowUncoDeserters.desc: Made to bring honour to a lord and glory to a soldier, this bow ended up in very unworthy hands.

BowUncoCompanions.name: Brotherhood's Bow
BowUncoCompanions.desc: Each Brotherhood bow is different: the owner of this one carved their children's first names on it.

BowUncoCraftT1.name: Longbow [L2]
BowUncoCraftT1.desc: Made from yew, this devastatingly powerful bow must be wielded with care.

BowBUncoCraftT1.name: Longbow [L4]
BowBUncoCraftT1.desc: Made from yew, this devastatingly powerful bow must be wielded with care.

BowCUncoCraftT1.name: Longbow [L6]
BowCUncoCraftT1.desc: Made from yew, this devastatingly powerful bow must be wielded with care.

BowUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Bow [L6]
BowUncoCraftT2.desc: Something in the monster's hide makes this bow easier to handle.

BowBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Bow [L8]
BowBUncoCraftT2.desc: Something in the monster's hide makes this bow easier to handle.

BowCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Bow [L10]
BowCUncoCraftT2.desc: Something in the monster's hide makes this bow easier to handle.

BowUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Bow [L12]
BowUncoCraftT3.desc: Who could have guessed that reinforcing a bow in this particular spot could make it so powerful?

BowBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Bow [L14]
BowBUncoCraftT3.desc: Who could have guessed that reinforcing a bow in this particular spot could make it so powerful?

BowCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Bow [L16]
BowCUncoCraftT3.desc: Who could have guessed that reinforcing a bow in this particular spot could make it so powerful?

BowRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Bow(L:15)
BowRareCraftT5.desc: The string of this bow is made of finely braided vairmeil.

BowRareGuard.name: War Bow
BowRareGuard.desc: By no means rare, this war bow is light and precise.

BowRareTrackers.name: Hunter's Bow
BowRareTrackers.desc: The Trackers are hunters above all else: this bow is their favourite weapon.

BowRareFugitive06.name: Liberator
BowRareFugitive06.desc: Unlike traditional Harag bows, no animal parts were used to craft the liberator.

BowRareFugitive12.name: Avenger
BowRareFugitive12.desc: Seething with hatred, Captain Eleora engraved the name of her enemy on her weapon.

BowRareInquisition.name: Herald of the Eye
BowRareInquisition.desc: Wielded by Inquisition messengers, these bows are laid out in bright sunlight for several days to receive the Eye's blessing.

BowRareInquisitionUp.name: Herald of the Eye
BowRareInquisitionUp.desc: Wielded by Inquisition messengers, these bows are laid out in bright sunlight for several days to receive the Eye's blessing.

BowLegendaryEliteWorld.name: The Indomitable One
BowLegendaryEliteWorld.desc: Kaghal engraved detailed figures into the wood of this bow. They recount the warrior's youth.

CrossbowLegendaryNarses.name: Narses' Crossbow
CrossbowLegendaryNarses.desc: It takes a lot of effort to load this crossbow, but its stopping power is second to none. This is probably due to its string, carefully woven from fibres strangely reminiscent of the Beast's fur.

BowLegendaryNarses.name: Narses' Bow
BowLegendaryNarses.desc: It takes a lot of effort to draw this bow, but its stopping power is second to none. This is probably due to its string, carefully woven from fibres strangely reminiscent of the Beast's fur.

BowLegendaryArenaH1.name: Sleuth
BowLegendaryArenaH1.desc: Under its ornaments and brass reinforcements, Sleuth used to be an authentic Tracker bow.

BowLegendaryArenaH.name: Sleuth
BowLegendaryArenaH.desc: Under its ornaments and brass reinforcements, Sleuth used to be an authentic Tracker bow.

BowLegendaryArenaHR.name: Sleuth - Billet
BowLegendaryArenaHR.desc: The workpiece required to craft the special weapon.

BowLegendaryArenaIR1.name: Fighter's Bow
BowLegendaryArenaIR1.desc: Lieutenant Merin is a fearsome archer who made her arena weapon herself.

BowLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Bow
BowLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: It's not uncommon to find charlatans in Gosenberg claiming to offer these bows for sale. To avoid any nasty surprises in combat, the Trackers recommend that you craft them yourself.

BowUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Bow
BowUncoThief.desc: The leather straps wound around this bow are trophies taken from the victims of various successful crimes.

FistStart.name: Thug's Katar
FistStart.desc: This katar was made from a belt and the tip of a sword.

FistRarePit1.name: Pit Claw
FistRarePit1.desc: There are versions of this claw without sharpened ends, but fighters and crowds find them far less exciting.

FistUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Katar [L2]
FistUncoCraftT1.desc: Broken fingers are a common occurrence for those first learning to handle a katar.

FistBUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Katar [L4]
FistBUncoCraftT1.desc: Broken fingers are a common occurrence for those first learning to handle a katar.

FistCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Katar [L6]
FistCUncoCraftT1.desc: Broken fingers are a common occurrence for those first learning to handle a katar.

FistUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Katar [L6]
FistUncoCraftT2.desc: Fighters wielding this claw always look fearsome.

FistBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Katar [L8]
FistBUncoCraftT2.desc: Fighters wielding this claw always look fearsome.

FistCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Katar [L10]
FistCUncoCraftT2.desc: Fighters wielding this claw always look fearsome.

FistUncoAlazar.name: Alazarian Katar
FistUncoAlazar.desc: The rimesteel's strength allows this katar to punch through all sorts of materials.

FistUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Katar [L12]
FistUncoCraftT3.desc: Every fighter dreams of owning a weapon like this.

FistBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Katar [L14]
FistBUncoCraftT3.desc: Every fighter dreams of owning a weapon like this.

FistCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Katar [L16]
FistCUncoCraftT3.desc: Every fighter dreams of owning a weapon like this.

FistArena.name: Arena Katar
FistArena.desc: These weapons are very popular in Belerion, and fans are willing to pay high prices to see them in action.

FistRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Cestus(L:15)
FistRareCraftT5.desc: With its all-vairmeil padding, this cestus finally gives you a way to eviscerate your enemies without injuring yourself!

FistCommonPirates.name: Pirate's Cestus
FistCommonPirates.desc: The guard on this cestus is badly damaged. Its owner must have used it to fend off his opponents' blows.

FistCommonBandits.name: Knuckles
FistCommonBandits.desc: Always in the pocket of any bandit, even if they are not in use.

FistUncoBelerion.name: Ihrian Katar
FistUncoBelerion.desc: The blade of this katar was designed to rip through the enemy's guts.

FistUncoTrackers.name: Tracker's Claw
FistUncoTrackers.desc: The Trackers use this claw to cover their tracks and shift the blame for their actions to poor, innocent bears.

FistUncoDeserters.name: Deserter's Katar
FistUncoDeserters.desc: It's no great surprise to find such a disreputable weapon in the hands of a deserter.

FistUncoOutlaws.name: Bandit's Katar
FistUncoOutlaws.desc: This weapon is part of what makes dark alleyways such a nightmare for villagers.

BigItemFragmenUU.name: Bandit's Claws
BigItemFragmenUU.desc: Dangerous and intimidating at the same time, no wonder they are so popular among bandits.

FistUncoCompanions.name: Brotherhood's Cestus
FistUncoCompanions.desc: The Brotherhood restricts use of the cestus to Mercenaries entrusted with discreet missions.

FistUncoSkelmar.name: Skelmar Katar
FistUncoSkelmar.desc: The Skelmar discovered katars during pillaging runs along the Edoranian coast. Though they originally looted them from the bodies of their victims, the tribes eventually learned how to make their own versions of these weapons.

FistLegendaryArenaB1.name: Ripper
FistLegendaryArenaB1.desc: Crafted from Akhedian steel, this weapon was made for arena fights but is perfectly suitable for the battlefield as well.

FistLegendaryArenaB.name: Ripper
FistLegendaryArenaB.desc: Crafted from Akhedian steel, this weapon was made for arena fights but is perfectly suitable for the battlefield as well.

FistLegendaryArenaBR.name: Ripper - Billet
FistLegendaryArenaBR.desc: The workpiece required to craft the special weapon.

LegendaryFistRuinB1.name: Sippur Katar
LegendaryFistRuinB1.desc: This katar is different to other ancient weapons. It seems simpler and less ornate.

LegendaryShieldRuinE2.name: Treasure of the Ancients
LegendaryShieldRuinE2.desc: The owner of this broken relic must have been an illustrious individual. A scholar might be able to reveal all of its secrets.

LegendarySword2HRuinIR2.name: Treasure of the Ancients
LegendarySword2HRuinIR2.desc: The owner of this broken relic must have been an illustrious individual. A Scholar might be able to reveal all of its secrets.

LegendaryCenserRuinsA2.name: Treasure of the Ancients
LegendaryCenserRuinsA2.desc: The owner of this fragmented relic must have been quite an illustrious individual. A Scholar could likely reveal its secrets.

FistLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Claw
FistLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: While this weapon is unlikely to be confused with one of the Beast's actual claws, it's still perfectly capable of gutting an enemy or running them through.

FistUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Katar
FistUncoThief.desc: This weapon was designed for those who love fighting with their fists, but don't like how long it takes.

CrossbowStart.name: Rusty Crossbow
CrossbowStart.desc: It's hard to guess how much longer this crossbow will hold together. Rust has started to affect the mechanism.

CrossbowCommonRoyalKnights.name: Knight's Crossbow
CrossbowCommonRoyalKnights.desc: Despite Alazar's suspicion towards this foreign invention, the Knights can't deny its effectiveness.

CrossbowUncoGuard.name: Guard Crossbow
CrossbowUncoGuard.desc: With its intentionally simple design, this crossbow can be handled by just about anyone, with no need for long and expensive training for Guard recruits.

CrossbowUncoLegion.name: Legion Crossbow
CrossbowUncoLegion.desc: The Legion is where the first crossbows started appearing just a few years back. Within its ranks, men say that with a weapon like this, the Harag war might have ended quite differently.

BowCommonLegioU.name: Legion Crossbow
BowCommonLegioU.desc: The Legion is where the first crossbows started appearing just a few years back. Within its ranks, men say that with a weapon like this, the Harag war might have ended quite differently.

HonorCrossbow.name: Honoured Crossbow
HonorCrossbow.desc: This weapon was rewarded during the years of service in the Legion. The owner of such a weapon is allowed to use it even after retirement.

CrossbowUncoInquisition.name: Inquisition Crossbow
CrossbowUncoInquisition.desc: Adapted from the Legion's crossbows, the Inquisition's preferred model boasts a tougher type of wood and a more complicated mechanism.

Anfluence.name: Inquisition Crossbow
Anfluence.desc: Adapted from the Legion's crossbows, the Inquisition's preferred model boasts a tougher type of wood and a more complicated mechanism.

CrossbowUncoAlazar.name: Alazar Crossbow
CrossbowUncoAlazar.desc: Crossbowmen enjoy little respect in Alazar, probably because their chosen weapon was invented by a rival kingdom.

CrossbowUncoAlazarU.name: Alazar Crossbow
CrossbowUncoAlazarU.desc: Crossbowmen enjoy little respect in Alazar, probably because their chosen weapon was invented by a rival kingdom.

CrossbowUncoSkelmar.name: Skelmar Crossbow
CrossbowUncoSkelmar.desc: It's quite ironic that a weapon created to fight the Skelmar is now so common in their ranks.

CrossbowUncoPirate.name: Pirate Crossbow
CrossbowUncoPirate.desc: Made from the hulls of their defeated enemies' ships, pirate crossbows also feature a unique mechanism.

CrossbowUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Crossbow [L2]
CrossbowUncoCraftT1.desc: This small, unpretentious crossbow is particularly easy to handle.

CrossbowBUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Crossbow [L4]
CrossbowBUncoCraftT1.desc: This small, unpretentious crossbow is particularly easy to handle.

CrossbowCUncoCraftT1.name: Iron Crossbow [L6]
CrossbowCUncoCraftT1.desc: This small, unpretentious crossbow is particularly easy to handle.

CrossbowArena.name: Arena Crossbow
CrossbowArena.desc: This small, unpretentious crossbow is particularly easy to handle.

CrossbowUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Crossbow [L6]
CrossbowUncoCraftT2.desc: When the string is released, it sounds like the scream of an unearthly monster.

CrossbowBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Crossbow [L8]
CrossbowBUncoCraftT2.desc: When the string is released, it sounds like the scream of an unearthly monster.

CrossbowCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Crossbow [L10]
CrossbowCUncoCraftT2.desc: When the string is released, it sounds like the scream of an unearthly monster.

CrossbowUncoCraftT4.name: Rimesteel Crossbow
CrossbowUncoCraftT4.desc: With its rimesteel construction, this crossbow is as solid as they come. One sometimes hears of crossbowmen using it as a mace after firing their last bolt.

CrossbowUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Crossbow [L12]
CrossbowUncoCraftT3.desc: The Akhedian steel gives this crossbow such incredible power that it could probably fire a bolt right through a horse.

CrossbowBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Crossbow [L14]
CrossbowBUncoCraftT3.desc: The Akhedian steel gives this crossbow such incredible power that it could probably fire a bolt right through a horse.

CrossbowCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Crossbow [L16]
CrossbowCUncoCraftT3.desc: The Akhedian steel gives this crossbow such incredible power that it could probably fire a bolt right through a horse.

CrossbowRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Crossbow(L:15)
CrossbowRareCraftT5.desc: This crossbow is a masterpiece of smithwork and alchemy. Once you try it, you’ll never go back.

CrossbowLegendaryArenaE2.name: Revenge (Doctored)
CrossbowLegendaryArenaE2.desc: By doctoring her crossbow's mechanism, Attia has achieved an unmatched rate of fire.

CrossbowLegendaryArenaE2Legal.name: Revenge
CrossbowLegendaryArenaE2Legal.desc: The doctored mechanism that made Revenge so fearsome in battle has been repaired. What it has lost in rate of fire, it has gained in durability.

CrossbowLegendaryChampion21.name: Ravager
CrossbowLegendaryChampion21.desc: By the look of it, this weapon shouldn't actually work. Its mechanism, its bow and even its stock all come from different crossbows, assembled in a way that's as haphazard as it is ridiculous. Yet few are as terrifyingly effective.

CrossbowLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Crossbow
CrossbowLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: The blacksmith who invented this crossbow never set foot in Harag, yet he was able to perfectly capture the essence of the Hunt with this weapon.

CrossbowUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Crossbow
CrossbowUncoThief.desc: This crossbow is a good match for those who prefer to keep a safe distance from the consequences of their crimes.

CenserStart.name: Clay Censer
CenserStart.desc: Although scholars consider Alazar to be the birthplace of modern thaumaturgy, priests have often used these censers to defend themselves from their inebriated flock.

CenserUncoCraftT1.name: Stoneware Censer [L2]
CenserUncoCraftT1.desc: This censer is particularly tough due to the extremely high kiln temperatures used to fire it.

CenserBUncoCraftT1.name: Stoneware Censer [L4]
CenserBUncoCraftT1.desc: This censer is particularly tough due to the extremely high kiln temperatures used to fire it.

CenserCUncoCraftT1.name: Stoneware Censer [L6]
CenserCUncoCraftT1.desc: This censer is particularly tough due to the extremely high kiln temperatures used to fire it.

CenserUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Censer [L6]
CenserUncoCraftT2.desc: Components from the Ghost Pack are said to prolong the effects of concoctions and fumigants.

CenserBUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Censer [L8]
CenserBUncoCraftT2.desc: Components from the Ghost Pack are said to prolong the effects of concoctions and fumigants.

CenserCUncoCraftT2.name: Ghost Censer [L10]
CenserCUncoCraftT2.desc: Components from the Ghost Pack are said to prolong the effects of concoctions and fumigants.

CenserUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Censer [L12]
CenserUncoCraftT3.desc: It feels almost criminal to waste such lovely bomblets on one's enemies.

CenserBUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Censer [L14]
CenserBUncoCraftT3.desc: It feels almost criminal to waste such lovely bomblets on one's enemies.

CenserCUncoCraftT3.name: Akhedian Censer [L16]
CenserCUncoCraftT3.desc: It feels almost criminal to waste such lovely bomblets on one's enemies.

CenserRareCraftT4.name: Akhedian Steel Censer [L12]
CenserRareCraftT4.desc: It feels almost criminal to waste such lovely bomblets on one's enemies.

CenserRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Censer(L:15)
CenserRareCraftT5.desc: A thin layer of vairmeil isolates the reagents in concoctions from the air and prevents them from oxidising.

CenserCommonOutlaws.name: Bandit's Censer
CenserCommonOutlaws.desc: After stealing them from churches, Bandits modify liturgical censers for their own purposes.

CenserCommonLoot.name: Contraband Censer
CenserCommonLoot.desc: This innocent censer has been modified in altogether illegal fashion by Belerion Smugglers.

WhitePaU.name: Witch's Censer
WhitePaU.desc: This innocent censer has been modified by its owner to suit her needs.

CenserUncoAlazar.name: Alazarian Censer
CenserUncoAlazar.desc: By studying tablets pillaged from Harag to learn about the weapons of the Ancients, Alazarian Scholars brought this ancient form of combat back to life.

CenserUncoInquisition.name: Inquisition Censer
CenserUncoInquisition.desc: The Inquisition Censer represents the face of a woman in tears: Arch-Heretic Tarcilla.

CenserUncoCompanions.name: Brotherhood Censer
CenserUncoCompanions.desc: This simple and elegant censer is becoming increasingly common in the ranks of the Brotherhood.

CenserUncoRoyalKnights.name: Fine Censer
CenserUncoRoyalKnights.desc: The King's Knights have the most beautiful and elaborate censers by far.

CenserRareTrackers.name: Tracker's Censer
CenserRareTrackers.desc: Trackers believe that the martial art of thaumaturgy originated in Harag, not Alazar. And indeed, its renaissance began with the pillaging of Tombs located in their lands.

CenserLegendaryArenaA2.name: Perseverance
CenserLegendaryArenaA2.desc: After having two censers confiscated for looking too much like the ones used by the Knights, Alfrid finally chose a more standard model and adapted it to his style.

CenserLegendaryRuinsA2.name: Belit's Censer
CenserLegendaryRuinsA2.desc: The design of this censer and of these strange bomblets is too bizarre to reproduce. They don't even seem all that likely to work.

CenserUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Censer
CenserUncoThief.desc: The secrets that went into crafting this censer disappeared with its creator, but the thief doesn't care much about that.

ShieldStart.name: Barrel Lid
ShieldStart.desc: A shield that gives off a faint odour of cheap wine.

ShieldCommonGeneric.name: Training Buckler
ShieldCommonGeneric.desc: This cute little shield reminds you of your childhood.

ShieldCommonGuard.name: Buckler of the Guard
ShieldCommonGuard.desc: A buckler that all bandits know very well.

ShieldCommonLegionary.name: Legion Buckler
ShieldCommonLegionary.desc: Many legionaries sleep with their buckler strapped to their back to ward off backstabbers.

ShieldCommonAlazar.name: Alazarian Buckler
ShieldCommonAlazar.desc: It is said that during the Edoranian War, Alazar cut down an entire forest to equip its army with bucklers like this one.

ShieldCommonSkelmar.name: Skelmar Kite Shield
ShieldCommonSkelmar.desc: The Skelmar sometimes use the tip of their kite shields to bash in their enemies' armour.

ShieldCommonCraftT1.name: Targe [L2]
ShieldCommonCraftT1.desc: A small wooden shield, sturdy and practical.

ShieldUncoAlazar.name: Alazarian Heater Shield
ShieldUncoAlazar.desc: Stamped with Alazar's emblem and bearing the king's colours, this shield is recognisable in all of the Five Kingdoms.

ShieldRareAlazar.name: Improved Alazarian Shield
ShieldRareAlazar.desc: Stamped with Alazar's emblem and bearing the king's colours, this shield is recognisable in all of the Five Kingdoms.

ShieldArena.name: Arena Heater Shield
ShieldArena.desc: With iron reinforcements, this wooden shield is sturdier and can deflect powerful blows.

ShieldUncoGeneric.name: Reinforced Training Buckler
ShieldUncoGeneric.desc: It seems the owner, unable to afford a real shield, simply reinforced their training buckler.

ShieldUncoSmugglers.name: Smuggler's Shield
ShieldUncoSmugglers.desc: All the paint was washed off the shield to conceal its origin.

ShieldUncoCompanions.name: Brotherhood's Shield
ShieldUncoCompanions.desc: This shield is standard issue in the Brotherhood, so much so that they made it their emblem.

ShieldDeflectionAT1.name: Reinforced Shield [L2]
ShieldDeflectionAT1.desc: A reinforced shield is a timeless classic among mercenaries.

ShieldDeflectionBT1.name: Reinforced Shield [L4]
ShieldDeflectionBT1.desc: A reinforced shield is a timeless classic among mercenaries.

ShieldDeflectionCT1.name: Reinforced Shield [L6]
ShieldDeflectionCT1.desc: A reinforced shield is a timeless classic among mercenaries.

ShieldDeflectionAT2.name: Veteran's Shield [L6]
ShieldDeflectionAT2.desc: This roundel was made to age with its owner.

ShieldDeflectionBT2.name: Veteran's Shield [L8]
ShieldDeflectionBT2.desc: This roundel was made to age with its owner.

ShieldDeflectionCT2.name: Veteran's Shield [L10]
ShieldDeflectionCT2.desc: This roundel was made to age with its owner.

ShieldDeflectionAT3.name: Golden Shield [L12]
ShieldDeflectionAT3.desc: The character painted on this shield looks like Saint Eleor, but some in the Legion claim that it actually represents General Edor.

ShieldDeflectionBT3.name: Golden Shield [L14]
ShieldDeflectionBT3.desc: The character painted on this shield looks like Saint Eleor, but some in the Legion claim that it actually represents General Edor.

ShieldDeflectionCT3.name: Golden Shield [L16]
ShieldDeflectionCT3.desc: The character painted on this shield looks like Saint Eleor, but some in the Legion claim that it actually represents General Edor.

ShieldRiposteAT1.name: Smuggler's Shield [L2]
ShieldRiposteAT1.desc: The patterns on this roundel are not engraved, but inlaid in the Ihrian style.

ShieldRiposteBT1.name: Smuggler's Shield [L4]
ShieldRiposteBT1.desc: The patterns on this roundel are not engraved, but inlaid in the Ihrian style.

ShieldRiposteCT1.name: Smuggler's Shield [L6]
ShieldRiposteCT1.desc: The patterns on this roundel are not engraved, but inlaid in the Ihrian style.

ShieldRiposteAT2.name: Ghost Shield [L6]
ShieldRiposteAT2.desc: Anyone would look intimidating with such a shield.

ShieldRiposteBT2.name: Ghost Shield [L8]
ShieldRiposteBT2.desc: Anyone would look intimidating with such a shield.

ShieldRiposteCT2.name: Ghost Shield [L10]
ShieldRiposteCT2.desc: Anyone would look intimidating with such a shield.

ShieldRiposteAT3.name: North Shield [L12]
ShieldRiposteAT3.desc: People usually paint this shield with their own colours.

ShieldRiposteBT3.name: North Shield [L14]
ShieldRiposteBT3.desc: People usually paint this shield with their own colours.

ShieldRiposteCT3.name: North Shield
ShieldRiposteCT3.desc: People usually paint this shield with their own colours.

ShieldBashAT1.name: Kite Shield [L2]
ShieldBashAT1.desc: The Skelmar sometimes use the tip of their kite shields to bash in their enemies' armour.

ShieldBashBT1.name: Kite Shield [L4]
ShieldBashBT1.desc: The Skelmar sometimes use the tip of their kite shields to bash in their enemies' armour.

ShieldBashCT1.name: Kite Shield [L6]
ShieldBashCT1.desc: The Skelmar sometimes use the tip of their kite shields to bash in their enemies' armour.

ShieldBashAT2.name: Reinforced Kite Shield [L6]
ShieldBashAT2.desc: Reinforced with iron or rimesteel, the shield is both an offensive and defensive tool.

ShieldBashBT2.name: Reinforced Kite Shield [L8]
ShieldBashBT2.desc: Reinforced with iron or rimesteel, the shield is both an offensive and defensive tool.

ShieldBashCT2.name: Reinforced Kite Shield [L10]
ShieldBashCT2.desc: Reinforced with iron or rimesteel, the shield is both an offensive and defensive tool.

ShieldBashAT3.name: Titan's Shield [L12]
ShieldBashAT3.desc: Only a true titan is able to use this shield.

ShieldBashBT3.name: Titan's Shield [L14]
ShieldBashBT3.desc: Only a true titan is able to use this shield.

ShieldBashCT3.name: Titan's Shield [L16]
ShieldBashCT3.desc: Only a true titan is able to use this shield.

ShieldAT4.name: Legionary Shield
ShieldAT4.desc: This distinctive shield played a crucial part in Edor's war.

ShieldBT4.name: Solar Shield
ShieldBT4.desc: Shields were never especially popular in Ihraa. Even so, this one was forged with a great deal of care.

ShieldCT4.name: Paladin’s Shield
ShieldCT4.desc: A staple of any self-respecting paladin's equipment, this scutum was blessed in the cathedral of Edoran.

ShieldDT4.name: Defender's Shield
ShieldDT4.desc: Nothing gets through defenders of the Guard equipped with heavy armour and this roundel.

ShieldRareCraftT5.name: Vairmeil Shield(L:15)
ShieldRareCraftT5.desc: This exceptionally lightweight shield is covered with a sheet of vairmeil to protect it from edged weapons.

ShieldBanner.name: Emblazoned Buckler
ShieldBanner.desc: A buckler on your Troop's symbol can be painted and which you can show off all over the world.

ShieldUncoBandits.name: Bandit Heater Shield
ShieldUncoBandits.desc: This shield has been amply used as a blunt weapon.

ShieldUncoTrackers.name: Haragian Buckler
ShieldUncoTrackers.desc: This buckler is designed to withstand the claws of the Ghost Pack monsters. You would be hard pushed to find a sturdier one.

ShieldUncoTrackersElite.name: Trackers' Buckler
ShieldUncoTrackersElite.desc: This buckler is designed to withstand the claws of the Ghost Pack monsters. You would be hard pushed to find a sturdier one.

ShieldUncoRoyalKnights.name: Knight's Shield
ShieldUncoRoyalKnights.desc: Each Knight can choose the design that appears on their shield – though they're not always particularly original, considering the Knights' strong tendency towards conformity.

ShieldRarePit1.name: Standard Heater Shield
ShieldRarePit1.desc: No matter where the fighters come from, this shield always bears the colours of the Black Market.

ShieldRareGeneric.name: Veteran's Roundel
ShieldRareGeneric.desc: This roundel was made to age with its owner.

ShieldCommonDeserter.name: Sentry's Shield
ShieldCommonDeserter.desc: Instead of doing the country proud, the sentry deserted and took the shield with them.

ShieldUncoDeserter.name: Deserters' Shield
ShieldUncoDeserter.desc: Instead of doing the army proud, they deserted and took the shield with them.

ShieldRareDeserter.name: Corporal's Roundel
ShieldRareDeserter.desc: Instead of doing his army proud, the corporal this roundel belonged to deserted and took the shield with him.

ShieldRareInquisition.name: Paladin’s Scutum
ShieldRareInquisition.desc: A staple of any self-respecting paladin's equipment, this scutum was blessed in the cathedral of Edoran.

ShieldUncoLegion.name: Officer's Scutum
ShieldUncoLegion.desc: This distinctive shield played a crucial part in Edor's war.

ShieldRareLegion.name: Elite Legion Scutum
ShieldRareLegion.desc: This distinctive shield played a crucial part in Edor's war.

ShieldRareGuard.name: Defender's Roundel
ShieldRareGuard.desc: Nothing gets through defenders of the Guard equipped with heavy armour and this roundel.

ShieldRarePirates.name: Privateer's Roundel
ShieldRarePirates.desc: The patterns on this roundel are not engraved, but inlaid in the Ihrian style.

ShieldRareBelerion.name: Solar Aspis
ShieldRareBelerion.desc: Shields were never especially popular in Ihraa. Even so, this one was forged with a great deal of care.

ShieldCommonBelerion.name: Aspis
ShieldCommonBelerion.desc: Shields were never especially popular in Ihraa. Even so, this one was forged with a great deal of care.

ShieldRareCompanion.name: Peacebearer's Roundel
ShieldRareCompanion.desc: Rumour has it that Brothers were seen breaking down doors using only their shield as a ram.

ShieldRareSkelmar.name: Ulfark's Kite Shield
ShieldRareSkelmar.desc: Though reinforced with iron or rimesteel, an Ulfark's kite shield still weighs the same as other Skelmar shields.

ShieldThorn.name: Bloodthirsty Heater Shield
ShieldThorn.desc: This shield becomes even more terrifying when parts of the wielder's opponents get stuck to it.

SwordCommonLegioL.name: Backhand Dagger
SwordCommonLegioL.desc: This left hand weapon was designed to support attacks of the other weapon.

ShortSwordLeftHand.name: Backhand Blade
ShortSwordLeftHand.desc: This ceremonial blade is often wielded by the nobility of Gosenberg.

CAG1.name: Smot's Dagger
CAG1.desc: The main purpose of this weapon is to poison opponents rather than dealing actual damage.

CAG.name: Smot's Dagger
CAG.desc: The main purpose of this weapon is to poison opponents rather than dealing actual damage.

CAGR.name: Smot's Dagger - Billet
CAGR.desc: The workpiece required to craft the special weapon.

ShieldGuardian.name: Guardian's Heater Shield
ShieldGuardian.desc: This shield was a symbol of the Laheart family for centuries. Nowadays, no lord uses it in combat for fear of damaging it.

PolearmLegendaryKrisked.name: Trident
PolearmLegendaryKrisked.desc: It is said that this weapons belonged to the Undersea King. The smugglers support such rumours to attract more audience to the Arena.

ShieldLegendaryArenaER.name: Trident - Billet
ShieldLegendaryArenaER.desc: The workpiece required to craft the special weapon.

ShieldLegendaryArenaIR1.name: Saga
ShieldLegendaryArenaIR1.desc: This shield belonged to a knight clad in gold from head to toe.

ShieldLegendaryRuinE2.name: Dumuzi's Aspis
ShieldLegendaryRuinE2.desc: This shield was forged to honour Dumuzi's protective spirit. Although it was never destined for war, it has all the qualities a soldier could hope for.

ShieldLegendaryCraftIR2.name: Beast's Targe
ShieldLegendaryCraftIR2.desc: The back of this targe is often covered with liturgical inscriptions, in case terror-stricken Trackers forget their customary prayers.

ShieldUncoThief.name: Wrongdoer's Shield
ShieldUncoThief.desc: This stolen shield both protects its owner and helps hide their wicked misdeeds.

BlindingPowder.name: Blinding Powder
BlindingPowder.desc: A little pouch of fine powder.

RagePowder.name: Powdered Rage
RagePowder.desc: This controversial powder contains spices that burn the eyes and nostrils of animals to make them more aggressive.

OdorousPowder.name: Pungent Powder
OdorousPowder.desc: The mix of plants and putrid flesh makes this powder very tempting to animals.

ConfusingPowder.name: Confusion Powder
ConfusingPowder.desc: This powder burns and itches when it comes into contact with the skin.

E3Powder.name: Flammable Powder
E3Powder.desc: This dense, sticky powder burns as reliably as pitch. Some tell horrible tales of alchemists who have breathed it in too deeply...

IncendiaryFlask.name: Incendiary Flask
IncendiaryFlask.desc: An alcohol-soaked rag inserted partway into a flask.

CGG2.name: Trivetta's Incendiary Flask
CGG2.desc: An alcohol-soaked rag inserted partway into a flask.

CGGR.name: Trivetta's Incendiary Flask
CGGR.desc: An alcohol-soaked rag inserted partway into a flask.

HandHeldFrag.name: Hand Bomblet
HandHeldFrag.desc: A small iron capsule filled with highly explosive powder.

HandRecoil.name: Recoil Bomblet
HandRecoil.desc: This bomblet contains spices that make your eyes and nose burn.

BeeBomb.name: Bee Bomblet
BeeBomb.desc: There are probably better things to do with this bee-filled box, but someone decided it would be a good idea to toss it at enemies.

CorrosiveBomb.name: Corrosive Bomblet
CorrosiveBomb.desc: When this bomblet explodes, it projects a liquid that can eat away at enemies' armour.

BeastSplashBomb.name: Beast's Flask
BeastSplashBomb.desc: When the liquid in this flask comes in contact with air, it evaporates in a bluish cloud not unlike the mist that surrounds the Beast.

PoisonedFlask.name: Poison Flask
PoisonedFlask.desc: Many people poisoned themselves when trying to use this type of poison.
