StakeT3.desc:
Impale a corpse on this stake to generate <influence>::value::</influence> during a Rest.
[ASSIGN] Doubles the [IconInf] gained from the corpse.

Trap.name: Trap
Trap.desc: This tool can be used to catch small animals during a Rest. Single use.

Snare.name: Hunting Gear
Snare.desc: [JOBASSIGN] produces ::value:: and ::value:: during a Rest.

SnareT2.name: Hunting Gear
SnareT2.desc: [JOBASSIGN] produces ::value:: and ::value:: during a Rest. Has a small chance of producing meat.

SnareT3.name: Hunting Gear
SnareT3.desc: [JOBASSIGN] produces ::value:: and ::value:: during a Rest. Has a strong chance of producing meat.

Banner.name: Banner
Banner.desc:
This banner represents the Troop and their pride.
[ASSIGN] Any assigned lieutenant will proudly carry this banner everywhere.

Chest.name: Camp Chest
Chest.desc:
Place the items you wish to keep in this chest.
[JOBASSIGN] Laundries the stolen items during a Rest.

ChestT2.name: Camp Chest
ChestT2.desc: Place the items you wish to keep in this chest. [JOBASSIGN] Laundries the stolen items during a Rest. [JOBASSIGN] +10.

ChestT3.name: Camp Chest
ChestT3.desc: Place the items you wish to keep in this chest. [JOBASSIGN] Laundries the stolen items during a Rest. [JOBASSIGN] +20. [JOBASSIGN] Produces 1 during a Rest

BrewBarrel.name: Brewing Vat
BrewBarrel.desc: [JOBASSIGN] Produces brewed fruit alcohol during a Rest. [JOBASSIGN] -1.

BrewBarrelT2.name: Brewing Vat
BrewBarrelT2.desc: [JOBASSIGN] Produces brewed fruit alcohol during a Rest. [JOBASSIGN] -1.

BrewBarrelT3.name: Brewing Vat
BrewBarrelT3.desc: [JOBASSIGN] produces brewed fruit alcohol during a Rest. [JOBASSIGN] -1.

BrewBarrelGosenberg.name: Gosenberg Winery Vat
BrewBarrelGosenberg.desc: [ASSIGN] Produces a bottle of <item>GosenbergWine</item> and generates <happy><good>1</good></happy> during a Rest.

Beehive.name: Beehive
Beehive.desc: [ASSIGN] Produces honey from plants during a Rest. [ASSIGN] -1.

WatchStool.name: Watchkeeping Stool
WatchStool.desc:
[ASSIGN] Security during a Rest <good>+20%</good>, chances of prisoners to escape <good>-60%</good>.
[ASSIGN] [Willpower] <good>+::value::</good> for each Companion.

DiceGame.name: Dices
DiceGame.desc: [ASSIGN] Generates <happy><good>+::value::</good></happy> during a Rest if two Companions are assigned.

DiceGameT2.name: Dices
DiceGameT2.desc: [ASSIGN] Generates <happy><good>+::value::</good></happy> during a Rest if two Companions are assigned.

DiceGameT3.name: Dices
DiceGameT3.desc: [ASSIGN] Generates <happy><good>+::value::</good></happy> during a Rest if two Companions are assigned.

Lute.name: Lute
Lute.desc:
Play songs in Taverns to earn [IconGold] and [IconInf].
[JOBASSIGN] Running speed <good>+5%</good>.

LuteT2.name: Lute
LuteT2.desc:
Play songs in taverns to earn [IconGold] and [IconInf].
[JOBASSIGN] Running speed <good>+5%</good>.
[JOBASSIGN] [Movement] <good>+1</good> for each Companion.

LuteT3.name: Lute
LuteT3.desc: Play songs in taverns to earn [IconGold] and [IconInf]. [JOBASSIGN] Running speed +5%. [JOBASSIGN] [Movement] +1 for each Companion. [JOBASSIGN] Fatigue -10%.

Whip.name: Whip
Whip.desc: [ASSIGN] Allows to whip Companions to encourage them to work. [ASSIGN] Proficiency gained by the Troop +10%.

CristalSkull.name: Crystal Skull
CristalSkull.desc: A marvel of glassware that looks both eerie and captivating. After a Rest, Companions next to the Skull will start their next fight with [AttackExaltation].

SoulCradle.name: Cradle of Souls
SoulCradle.desc: An unknown essence is trapped inside this glass egg. After a Rest, Companions next to the Cradle gain [Satiated].

CelestialInstrument.name: Astral Instrument
CelestialInstrument.desc: One can track the course of the stars through the lens of this incredibly accurate mechanism. After a Rest, Companions next to the Instrument will start their next fight with [Inspiration].

Automaton.name: Musical Automaton
Automaton.desc: A protective effigy that looks strangely like a Tule. After a Rest, Companions next to the Automaton will start their next fight with [DefenseExaltation].

SolarSystem.name: Solar System
SolarSystem.desc: Multiple spherical worlds spinning through the air. After a Rest, Companions next to the System gain [Inspired].

Haystack.name: Haystack
Haystack.desc:
This haystack could serve either as a makeshift bed for a Companion, or as a tasty snack for a horse. Decisions, decisions...
[ASSIGN] Generates <happy><good>+::value::</good></happy> during a Rest.
[ASSIGN] Gains <ap><good>+::value::</good></ap> during a Rest.

TreeStump.name: Tree Stump
TreeStump.desc:
A thick, golden-tinged liquid oozes from a long gash across the trunk.
[JOBASSIGN] Gathers <item>Resin</item> during a Rest.

EyeAltar.name: Altar of the Eye
EyeAltar.desc:
There's no guarantee that anything will happen if you pray here. But what really worries you is what might happen if you don't.
[ASSIGN] Gives a random Bonus until the next Rest.

FieldsVines.name: Vine
FieldsVines.desc:
Someone patiently planted and tended to this vine so it would someday yield fine fruit like these.
[ASSIGN] Gathers <item>Grape</item> during a Rest.

Well.name: Well
Well.desc: This cool, clear water will quench your thirst better than any Gosenberg wine. [ASSIGN] Generates +::value:: during a Rest. [ASSIGN] -::value::.

RabbitHole.name: Burrow
RabbitHole.desc:
Animal tracks lead to the entrance to this hole, which is littered with fine hairs.
[ASSIGN] Produces <item>GameMeat</item> during a Rest.

Track.name: Trail
Track.desc:
This flattened carcass is a treasure trove of information for a Huntsman. You will also be able to find new traces left by the Beast more easily.
[JOBASSIGN]
- Generates a bit of Knowledge of the Beast at each Rest.

RuinMonolith.name: Bookshelf
RuinMonolith.desc: You doubt you’d be able to decipher any of this text. But since you’re stuck here, you may as well give it a try. [JOBASSIGN] Gains a little of the Proficiency during a Rest. [JOBASSIGN] Gains a little of [IconKn] during a Rest. [JOBASSIGN] Adds a chance to find SmallItemFragments during a Rest.

PlainMonolith.name: Monolith
PlainMonolith.desc: This stone has no particular meaning for ordinary mortals, but a Scholar might learn something unexpected from it. [JOBASSIGN] Gains a little of the Proficiency during a Rest. [JOBASSIGN] Gains a little of [IconKn] during a Rest. [JOBASSIGN] Adds a chance to find SmallItemFragments during a Rest.

BoatChest.name: Hold
BoatChest.desc: Store any items you wish to keep on board.

WerewolvesLab.name: Field Laboratory
WerewolvesLab.desc: A field laboratory that fits everything a Scholar needs to study the Weald and its lycanthropes onto a single desktop. Use it to conduct research using grafts, which unlock knowledge or recipes. [JOBASSIGN] produces ::value:: [AlchemicResidue] during each Rest.

WerewolvesLabT2.name: Field Laboratory
WerewolvesLabT2.desc: A field laboratory that fits everything a Scholar needs to study the Weald and its lycanthropes onto a single desktop. Use it to conduct research using grafts, which unlock knowledge or recipes. [JOBASSIGN] produces ::value:: [AlchemicResidue] during each Rest.

WerewolvesLabT3.name: Field Laboratory
WerewolvesLabT3.desc: A field laboratory that fits everything a Scholar needs to study the Weald and its lycanthropes onto a single desktop. Use it to conduct research using grafts, which unlock knowledge or recipes. [JOBASSIGN] produces ::value:: [AlchemicResidue], plus a type of flower from among those owned, during each Rest.

Anvil.name: Anvil
Anvil.desc: Choose a companion to forge weapons and armour using resources like ore, leather, wood ect.

ApothecaryTable.name: Apothecary Table
ApothecaryTable.desc: Choose a companion to prepare medicines using herbs and various alchemical components.

Tavern_FurnaceT1.name: Oven
Tavern_FurnaceT1.desc:
Can assign up to [Tool_Capacity] Scullions.
[JOBASSIGN]
- Produces meals to order.

Tavern_FurnaceT2.name: Improved Oven
Tavern_FurnaceT2.desc:
Can assign up to [Tool_Capacity] Scullions.
[JOBASSIGN]
- Produces meals to order.

Tavern_FurnaceT3.name: Perfect Oven
Tavern_FurnaceT3.desc:
Can assign up to [Tool_Capacity] Scullions.
[JOBASSIGN]
- Produces meals to order.

Tavern_Cave.name: Cellar
Tavern_Cave.desc: Barrels and their assigned Vintners are located here. Select the types of alcohol produced, set sales prices, and manage ageing.

Tavern_BarrelT1.name: Tavern Barrel
Tavern_BarrelT1.desc:
Can hold up to [TavernBarrelCapacity] servings of alcohol. This tool goes in the Tavern's Cellar.
[JOBASSIGN]
- Produces or refines alcohol during each Shift.

Tavern_BarrelT2.name: Upgraded Tavern Barrel
Tavern_BarrelT2.desc:
Can hold up to [TavernBarrelCapacity] servings of alcohol. This tool goes in the Tavern's Cellar.
[JOBASSIGN]
- Produces or refines alcohol during each Shift.

Tavern_LuthT1.name: Tavern Lute
Tavern_LuthT1.desc:
[JOBASSIGN]
- Grants Comfort based on Profession level.
- Increases sale odds for all patrons in the area, based on Profession level.

Tavern_LuthT2.name: Improved Tavern Lute
Tavern_LuthT2.desc:
[JOBASSIGN]
- Grants Comfort based on Profession level.
- Increases sale odds for all patrons in the area, based on Profession level.

Tavern_BountyBoard.name: List of Bounties
Tavern_BountyBoard.desc: - Allows the Troop to accept ::value:: additional contracts.

Tavern_Chicken.name: Chicken
Tavern_Chicken.desc: Accompanies Bards' singing and boosts their range.

Tavern_LandscapePaintingT1.name: Landscape Painting
Tavern_LandscapePaintingT1.desc: - Attracts different factions depending on the region depicted.

Tavern_LandscapePaintingT2.name: Improved Landscape Painting
Tavern_LandscapePaintingT2.desc: - Attracts different factions depending on the region depicted.

Tavern_WeaponDisplayT1.name: Weapon Display
Tavern_WeaponDisplayT1.desc:
- Use to exhibit up to ::maxWeapons:: weapons.
- Grants <TavernPrestige>::value::</TavernPrestige> per legendary weapon during each Shift.

Tavern_WeaponDisplayT2.name: Improved Weapon Display
Tavern_WeaponDisplayT2.desc:
- Use to exhibit up to ::maxWeapons:: weapons.
- Grants <TavernPrestige>::value::</TavernPrestige> per legendary weapon during each Shift.

Tavern_PuzzleManTavern.name: Portrait of Solvius, the Great Solveriser

Tavern_Rock.name: The Great Scholar of Alazar's Stone
Tavern_Rock.desc: Despite its magical properties, this stone looks like a common pebble.

TavernBasicWall.name: Basic Wall
TavernBasicWall.desc: Same walls as when you first moved in. The main thing is that they're holding the roof up... for now.

TavernBasicGround.name: Basic Floor
TavernBasicGround.desc: Not sure if you can really call this a "floor", or if it's just "the ground". There's no noticeable difference between inside and outside.

TavernRusticWall.name: Rustic Wall
TavernRusticWall.desc: The natural ruggedness of wood creates a warm, welcoming atmosphere.

TavernRusticGround.name: Rustic Floor
TavernRusticGround.desc: A few rough elements are enough to improve the look of the space without taking away from its natural simplicity.

TavernFancyWall.name: Stylish Wall
TavernFancyWall.desc: The light colour of these walls gives an impression of cleanliness that most Taverns lack.

TavernFancyGround.name: Stylish Floor
TavernFancyGround.desc: The materials are admirably refined, but not everyone will feel at home in such an opulent setting.

Gems.name: Gems
Gems.desc: These brightly coloured stones can be used as inlays in jewellery and crowns.

Silver.name: Silver
Silver.desc: A rare metal that is difficult to produce and is used primarily to measure an individual's success and power.

Pottery.name: Pottery
Pottery.desc: Somewhere between handicraft and art, pieces of pottery can be tricky items to travel with, due to their propensity to break.

Furs.name: Pelts
Furs.desc: Making fur is harder than you think, as its value depends on a large number of variables.

Parchment.name: Scrolls
Parchment.desc: Prized by scholars everywhere, these scrolls will also be of interest to Merchants and Lord Mayors who like keep track of their finances.

Spices.name: Spices
Spices.desc: Mysterious substances for the commoners who gape at their colours while the aristocrats savour their flavours.

Linen.name: Woollen Cloth
Linen.desc: Whilst the quality of the wool is important, it is the method of weaving which determines the fabric's market value.

Amber.name: Amber
Amber.desc: Amber is prized for both its aesthetic qualities and its supposed curative properties.

Perfumes.name: Perfumes
Perfumes.desc: The delicate scents of Ihrian perfumes are far superior to anything produced in the Five Kingdoms.

Incense.name: Marble
Incense.desc: The archipelago's once-flourishing marble trade has slowed somewhat due to pirate activity.

TGPlagueRemedy.name: Plague Remedies
TGPlagueRemedy.desc: Fragile and valuable goods that are most likely contraband.

Knowledge.name: Knowledge
Knowledge.desc: The Knowledge allows to learn new blueprints, patterns and recipes from the Compendium.

Discovery.name: Discovery
Discovery.desc: Discover new areas to fill the progress bar and earn [IconKn].

PathMightKnowledge.name: Knowledge: Power and Justice
PathMightKnowledge.desc: One point is available to unlock a bonus in the path of Power and Justice.

PathTradeKnowledge.name: Knowledge: Trade and Craftsmanship
PathTradeKnowledge.desc: One point is available to unlock a bonus in the path of Trade and Craftsmanship.

PathCrimeKnowledge.name: Knowledge: Crime and Chaos
PathCrimeKnowledge.desc: One point is available to unlock a bonus in the path of Crime and Chaos.

PathMysteryKnowledge.name: Knowledge: Mysteries and Wisdom
PathMysteryKnowledge.desc: One point is available to unlock a bonus in the path of Mysteries and Wisdom.

RunAbility.name: Run
RunAbility.desc: The Troop can run for short periods of time. Perfect to get away from pursuers.

EnduranceTraining.name: Endurance Training
EnduranceTraining.desc: The Troop is improving its stamina, and can travel a longer distance.

CareerPlan.name: Career Plans
CareerPlan.desc: Allows to have enhanced control over Companions' evolution when they level up.

Restauration.name: Restoration
Restauration.desc: The Troop improves their armour maintenance skills.

Rationing.name: Fire in the Eyes
Rationing.desc: The Companions are now more active and trying to learn about the world around them.

WeightTraining.name: Weighted Training
WeightTraining.desc: The Troop has trained with weights and can now carry heavy loads over long distances.

Frugality.name: Frugality
Frugality.desc: Each Companion agrees to a cut in their wages for the greater good.

ActionPointBonus1.name: Feat Makers
ActionPointBonus1.desc: The Companions are ready to fight and shine with glory on the battlefield.

FightForGold.name: For Money!
FightForGold.desc: Companions will search bodies in the most incongruous places to find Krowns.

BidHunters.name: Offer Hunters
BidHunters.desc: The Companions are bribing the Bounty Emissary to get more Missions.

BountiesStream.name: Bountiful Bounties
BountiesStream.desc: The Troop is improving their organisational skills and seeks to accumulate more bounties.

Orientation.name: Location Markers
Orientation.desc: The Troop can add objective markers to the map using [RMB].

Cannibalism.name: Cannibalism
Cannibalism.desc: The Troop is prepared to do anything to survive, including eating their own...

HumanTannery.name: Miscellaneous Tanning
HumanTannery.desc: The Companions no longer have any qualms about treating a human like an animal.

Cunning.name: Artful Dodgers
Cunning.desc: The Companions are honing their criminal skills and learning to master the art of stealth.

RecruitCostReduced.name: Smooth Talk
RecruitCostReduced.desc: The Companions become great spokespersons who can talk anyone into joining their ranks.

MasterThieves.name: Master Thieves
MasterThieves.desc: Thievery is no longer a job, but an art. And the Companions are the artisans.

WhipToDeath.name: Make an example of them!
WhipToDeath.desc: The Troop fears being whipped by too strong a hand.

PoisonMastery.name: Poison Mastery
PoisonMastery.desc: The Companions are learning how to use toxic plants and infectious reagents to cause the most painful death.

BleedingMastery.name: Bleeding Mastery
BleedingMastery.desc: The Companions are learning the delicate art of butchery on the battlefield.

BurningMastery.name: Burning Mastery
BurningMastery.desc: The Troop is developing a strong taste for seared flesh.

DrinkMate.name: Drinking Buddies
DrinkMate.desc: Best friends can get drunk together to forget their woes.

MisanthropicTroop.name: Misanthropes
MisanthropicTroop.desc: Companions who are on bad terms can toughen up by aggravating their quarrels even more.

HumanResources.name: Human Resources
HumanResources.desc: The Troop can publish Vacancy Notices through innkeepers.

ImprovedOrientation.name: Methodical Exploration
ImprovedOrientation.desc: The talented explorers the Troop is can mark points of interest on the map.

MasteringBullying.name: Intimidation
MasteringBullying.desc: Bandits have reduced aggression range and give up the chase faster.

MoralStrength.name: Fortitude
MoralStrength.desc: The Companions encourage one another and their willpower gets stronger.

InveterateTravellers.name: Seasoned Travellers
InveterateTravellers.desc: The Companions travelled so much that they can now walk longer before getting tired.

SkilfulExtraction.name: Skilful Extraction
SkilfulExtraction.desc: The Companions are skilled enough to gather several samples on plague-infested outgrowths.

AdjustedEquipment.name: Optimised Gear
AdjustedEquipment.desc: The Companions know how to increase their armour's efficiency by wearing matching helmets.

HealthyCommunication.name: Good Communication
HealthyCommunication.desc: The Troop is organised so well that relationships grow more easily.

SkilfulGatherers.name: Experienced Gatherers
SkilfulGatherers.desc: The Companions can recognise plant varieties and make the most of what they find along the way.

RestaurationForgeGosenberg.name: Gosenberg Methods
RestaurationForgeGosenberg.desc: Following Harag methods, the Troop improves techniques used in crafting and gear maintenance.

RestaurationForgeEdoran.name: Edoranian Methods
RestaurationForgeEdoran.desc: Following Harag methods, the Troop improves techniques used in crafting and gear maintenance.

RestaurationForgeHarag.name: Harag Methods
RestaurationForgeHarag.desc: Following Harag methods, the Troop improves techniques used in crafting and gear maintenance.

RestaurationForgeTiltren.name: Tiltren Methods
RestaurationForgeTiltren.desc: Following Tiltren methods, the Troop improves techniques used in crafting and gear maintenance.

RestaurationForgeAlazar.name: Alazarian Methods
RestaurationForgeAlazar.desc: Following Harag methods, the Troop improves techniques used in crafting and gear maintenance.

RestaurationForgeBelerion.name: Belerian Methods
RestaurationForgeBelerion.desc: Following Harag methods, the Troop improves techniques used in crafting and gear maintenance.

Rationning2.name: Basic Training
Rationning2.desc: The Companions prepare thoroughly before battles and often visit the Training Grounds.

FightForRenown.name: For Glory!
FightForRenown.desc: The Troop tends to boast after beating an opponent.

FightForPower.name: For power!
FightForPower.desc: The Troop learns more from their fights.

ActionPointBonus2.name: Bravest of the Brave
ActionPointBonus2.desc: The Troop is highly trained and ready to do anything to win. With class.

Ruthless.name: Ruthless
Ruthless.desc: Defeating the first opponents greatly increases chances of victory.

Opportunism.name: Opportunists
Opportunism.desc: The Companions learn to take advantage of their opponents' weaknesses.

MoreLayers.name: Master Craftsmen
MoreLayers.desc: As long as a piece of armour is properly cared for, it is possible to improve it beyond the usual limitations.

NonDestroyedLayers.name: Careful Salvagers
NonDestroyedLayers.desc: The Companions learn to take better care of their equipment.

Forgecraft.name: Art of the Forge
Forgecraft.desc: The Troop can rely on passionate and diligent blacksmiths.

ForgecraftExtra.name: Custom Smithing
ForgecraftExtra.desc: Blacksmiths make sure that the armour fits their customers.

ForgeTrade.name: Trade of Forged Goods
ForgeTrade.desc: The Troop can count on substantial income from their forge.

LeftHandedSpecialist.name: Left-hand Specialists
LeftHandedSpecialist.desc: Having two hands means they should both be used efficiently.

PathRunners.name: Trade Caravans
PathRunners.desc: The Troop is learning how to use roads and trails for quick travel.

PathPosts.name: Trade Posts
PathPosts.desc: The Troop finds opportunities to build Travel Posts and enlists the support of the Peddlers' Guild.

Carrier.name: Transporters
Carrier.desc: The more the Troop carries, the more they can sell. That is the key to becoming rich.

Negociator.name: Negotiators
Negociator.desc: Patrons offering missions can be more generous with their bounties. All it takes is a little explaining.

MissionGold.name: Valued Mercenaries
MissionGold.desc: A Troop as renowned as this one deserves to be paid more than others.

PrestigiousMercenaries.name: Reputable Mercenaries
PrestigiousMercenaries.desc: Thanks to their fame, the Troop has preferences in the Brotherhood and can take on more missions.

TradeGoodsBought.name: Suppliers
TradeGoodsBought.desc: The Troop knows how to get better prices from merchants.

TradeMissionDone.name: Skilful Merchants
TradeMissionDone.desc: Knowing how to offer buyers exactly what they need is a very lucrative art.

MasterFollower.name: Masters and Disciples
MasterFollower.desc: Self-learning is important, but sharing in the knowledge of elders can be just as beneficial.

LuxuriesSold.name: Goldsmiths
LuxuriesSold.desc: It’s always profitable to sell what the rich can buy at inflated prices.

PrisonnersGiven.name: Untouchables
PrisonnersGiven.desc: Serving justice for money can also do wonders for one’s reputation.

Cooperative.name: Cooperative
Cooperative.desc: Wages are negotiated downwards for the good of the Troop.

TradeHorses.name: Trade Animals
TradeHorses.desc: With better harnesses, animals can carry more.

MerchantFought.name: Highwaymen
MerchantFought.desc: Knowing where to find Krowns is key to being a successful brigand.

TrueBandits.name: Great Highwaymen
TrueBandits.desc: They are not born great, they become great. But not necessarily through honest work.

AmbushDone.name: Unprincipled
AmbushDone.desc: A successful ambush reduces risks while maximising loot.

Backstabs.name: Backstabbing
Backstabs.desc: Attacking an enemy from behind is not cowardice, but strategy.

NonLetal.name: Non-lethal
NonLetal.desc: The Troop learns where to strike to avoid damaging future workers.

Bandits.name: Ruffians
Bandits.desc: Forests are home to plants, animals and those who want to lie low.

AssassinApprentice.name: Assassins in the Making
AssassinApprentice.desc: The Companions have no more qualms about taking on the most dubious missions.

StolenItemsCount.name: Nimble Fingers
StolenItemsCount.desc: The Companions are getting better at stealing stealthily.

WantedDuration.name: Innocents
WantedDuration.desc: A successful criminal needs to look as innocent as possible and know how to keep a low profile.

Awareness.name: Vigilant
Awareness.desc: Anticipate. Predict. Prepare. These are the operative words to turn any situation to advantage.

SoldStolenItemsCount.name: Regular Customers
SoldStolenItemsCount.desc: Fences are no different from other thieves. The Troop needs to speak their language to get good prices.

SoldStolenItemsCountExtra.name: Shady Traders
SoldStolenItemsCountExtra.desc: Shady traders find good prices in shady business.

Parley.name: Negotiate
Parley.desc: A poignant and impassioned speech can sway anyone.

Scapegoat.name: Scapegoats
Scapegoat.desc: Throwing unanimous accusations all at once can make just about anyone seem guilty.

RunLonger.name: Marathon
RunLonger.desc: After all that travelling around, the Troop can now run longer.

Ascetism.name: Technologies
Ascetism.desc: The Companions use modern technologies when working with armour.

Encyclopedist.name: Archivist
Encyclopedist.desc: The Troop studies history, but mostly tries to make their own mark by sharing their story.

Archaeologist.name: Archaeologists
Archaeologist.desc: For the pursuit of knowledge, antiques are priceless. But then again, a price can always be negotiated.

LegendCollectors.name: Restorers of Legends
LegendCollectors.desc: A weapon that’s more famous than its wielder deserves to be used to its full potential.

LegendCollectorsExtra.name: Brotherhood Bond
LegendCollectorsExtra.desc: The Troop has some connections within the Brotherhood.

PestControl.name: Experimenters
PestControl.desc: No one wants to set foot in those disgusting nests. All the more prestige for the Troop.

Cleaner.name: Great Alchemists
Cleaner.desc: Such knowledge allows the Troop to reach a new level.

Poachers.name: Basic Education
Poachers.desc: The Troop learns how to study properly.

TrackersLanguage.name: Trackers’ Language
TrackersLanguage.desc: Trackers know and recognise the Troop.

MoreLights.name: Enlightened Opinions
MoreLights.desc: It’s important to follow a guiding light, be it spiritual or physical.

AnimalInstinct.name: Animal Instinct
AnimalInstinct.desc: To respect nature is to understand it without destroying it.

BeastKnowledge.name: Knowledge of the Beast
BeastKnowledge.desc: This Knowledge will help your Huntsmen to find traces left by the Beast, or to prepare to fight it.

BeastKnowledgeTerrorResist.name: Unflappable
BeastKnowledgeTerrorResist.desc: Your units can resist [VALUE(BeastKnowledgeTerrorResist)] more application(s) of [Terror] before fleeing the battle.

BeastKnowledgeInfluencePower.name: Ghostly Ferocity
BeastKnowledgeInfluencePower.desc: Each application of [BeastInfluence] on an allied animal increases its damage by an additional [VALUE(BeastKnowledgeInfluencePower)]%.

BeastKnowledgeTrackerTrade.name: Negotiation
BeastKnowledgeTrackerTrade.desc: Your next ::count:: purchases at the Trackers' Guild will cost [VALUE(TrackersMerchantsPriceReduction)]% less.

ResolutionMoreTransport.name: Expected Profits
ResolutionMoreTransport.desc: Until the next Rest, the Troop is willing to be encumbered in order to carry more valuable items.

ResolutionMoreXp.name: Swift Progress
ResolutionMoreXp.desc: Until the next Rest, what doesn't kill the Companions makes them stronger!

ResolutionMoreGather.name: Coordinated Gathering
ResolutionMoreGather.desc: Until the next Rest, the Troop gathers more resources.

ResolutionMoreKnowledge.name: Thirst for Knowledge
ResolutionMoreKnowledge.desc: Until the next Rest, the Troop pays closer attention to the details of their surroundings.

ResolutionMoreLoot.name: Respect for the Enemy
ResolutionMoreLoot.desc: Until the next Rest, the Troop earns more loot after a fight.

ResolutionSellPriceCraftedItems.name: Trade Fair
ResolutionSellPriceCraftedItems.desc: Until the next Rest, the Troop proudly announces that they are holding a great fair to sell equipment and items they crafted.

ResolutionNoWanted.name: Faking Innocence
ResolutionNoWanted.desc: Until the next Rest, the Troop acts as an ordinary group, less likely to draw the attention of local authorities.

ResolutionForcedMarch.name: Overflowing Motivation
ResolutionForcedMarch.desc: Until the next Rest, the Troop is motivated by greed and feels a surge of energy, which helps them travel longer.

ResolutionFreeVP.name: Vow of Valour
ResolutionFreeVP.desc: Until the next Rest, your Troop swears to show courage and valour in combat.

PoneyItem.name: Horse
PoneyItem.desc: A bright-eyed horse with hair as soft as silk.

PitFoeWeaponSword.name: Pit Straight Sword
PitFoeWeaponSword.desc: The coat of arms of this sword's previous owner has been artfully concealed with the colours of the Black Market.

PitFoeWeaponShield.name: Standard Heater Shield
PitFoeWeaponShield.desc: No matter where the fighters come from, this shield always bears the colours of the Black Market.

PitFoeWeaponMace.name: Studded Pit Mace
PitFoeWeaponMace.desc: The incredible weight of this mace is balanced by its impressive efficiency.

PitFoeWeaponDagger.name: Pit Dagger
PitFoeWeaponDagger.desc: A handsome blade offered to participants from the Black Market's equally handsome profits.

PitFoeWeaponBomb.name: Frag Bomblet
PitFoeWeaponBomb.desc: A small iron capsule filled with highly explosive powder.

PitFoeWeaponFist.name: Pit Claw
PitFoeWeaponFist.desc: There are versions of this claw without sharpened ends, but fighters and crowds find them far less exciting.

PitFoeWeapon2HSword.name: Pit Longsword
PitFoeWeapon2HSword.desc: Taking a bit more damage with every fight, this sword will likely end up breaking at the worst possible moment.

PitFoeWeapon2HMace.name: Large Studded Pit Mace
PitFoeWeapon2HMace.desc: Rumour has it that this mace actually comes from one of the Pit traps. After losing his weapon, a desperate fighter supposedly tore it out of the mechanism.

PitFoeWeaponPolearm.name: Pit Pike
PitFoeWeaponPolearm.desc: In his youth, the Baron fought with a spear very similar to this one.

PitFoeWeapon2HAxe.name: Pit Great Axe
PitFoeWeapon2HAxe.desc: Black Market rules state that the blade of this great axe must be dulled. But no one has really taken the time to check.

PitFoeWeaponBow.name: Pit Bow
PitFoeWeaponBow.desc: Despite a coat or two of rather convincing silver paint, this bow is made of ordinary wood.

PitFoeWeaponAxe.name: Pit Cleaver
PitFoeWeaponAxe.desc: This weapon is very popular in the Black Market Pit, and guarantees a rousing show every time.

FiefArmor.name: Militiaman's Armour
FiefArmor.desc: Tough, yet inexpensive to produce, this armour is perfect for members of the Militia.

Dice.name: Wooden Dice
Dice.desc: Little cubes that you can throw on a table, or in your opponent's face.

Arrows.name: Arrows
Arrows.desc: Perfect for filling up the quivers of the Fief's defenders.

PlayTokens.name: Game Tokens
PlayTokens.desc: They may not be as precious as the ones used by the Brokers, but they still do the job.

SongFief.name: Musical Compositions
SongFief.desc: The Scholars explore the delicate art of music, creating pieces that are harmonious, though hardly classical.

FiefArmorRenfort.name: Militiaman's Armour Layer
FiefArmorRenfort.desc: It may not be the most effective armour layer, but it's better than nothing.

ClayTablet.name: Clay Tablet
ClayTablet.desc: Scholars can go through dozens of these a day if you let them.

AlazarLantern.name: Lantern
AlazarLantern.desc: It takes years for a Master Blacksmith to learn the art of making Lanterns that can resist the winds of the Weald.

AlazarLanternT2.name: Radiant Lantern
AlazarLanternT2.desc: By lightening the Lantern's structure, your Companions have made room for larger fuel reserves.

AlazarLanternT3.name: Blazing Lantern
AlazarLanternT3.desc: Thanks to their knowledge of the Weald, your Companions have found a way to increase the Lantern's capacity without reducing its efficacy.

ResearchCraftLanternOilWeak.name: ::recipe_name[0]::
ResearchCraftLanternOilWeak.desc: Teaches you to make ::recipe_name[0]:: in the Workshop. ::recipe_desc[0]::

ResearchSanityProtection.name: At Home in the Dark
ResearchSanityProtection.desc: When sanity is below 50%, the Troop starts fights in the Weald with [Protection] for 2 turns.

ResearchLightLowSanity.name: Nocturnal Focus
ResearchLightLowSanity.desc: When sanity is below 50%, the [AlazarLantern] lights a larger area.

ResearchSanityLightReduceLoss.name: Reassuring Light
ResearchSanityLightReduceLoss.desc: The Troop loses sanity 10% slower when the [AlazarLantern] is at maximum intensity.

ResearchLightMotivation.name: Blazing Motivation
ResearchLightMotivation.desc: The Troop starts fights in the Weald with [Motivation] when the [AlazarLantern] is at maximum intensity.

ResearchLightBonusWerewolf.name: Night Vision
ResearchLightBonusWerewolf.desc: The [AlazarLantern] lights a larger area when the Troop has a transformed [Werewolf].

ResearchLightSpeedIncrease.name: Adrenaline Rush
ResearchLightSpeedIncrease.desc: The Troop moves faster in the Weald when the [AlazarLantern]'s oil supply is at 25% or less.

ResearchLightBright.name: Improved Combustion
ResearchLightBright.desc: The [AlazarLantern] gains a second level of intensity. When it is activated, explored areas are revealed on the map.

InjectionGamma.name: Lycanthrope Elixir
InjectionGamma.desc: This vial contains a liquid that no sane person would want to drink.

InjectionBeta.name: Hypertrophic Lycanthrope Elixir
InjectionBeta.desc: There's something unsettling about the swirling colours in this elixir.

InjectionPackInstinct.name: Pack Instinct Injection
InjectionPackInstinct.desc: A syringe with a disturbingly long needle.

InjectionCorrosiveBite.name: Corrosive Bite Injection
InjectionCorrosiveBite.desc: Once injected, this concoction quickly spreads through the veins, burning everything in its path.

InjectionInfecting.name: Infectious Injection
InjectionInfecting.desc: The solution in this flask is so full of miasmas that they're practically visible to the naked eye.

InjectionMetabolic.name: Metabolic Injection
InjectionMetabolic.desc: This syringe is designed to plunge deep into the patient's muscles.

MuscleStimulator.name: Muscle Stimulant
MuscleStimulator.desc: Use to upgrade a lycanthrope skill.

WerewolfPartialRemedy.name: Partial Lycanthropic Remedy
WerewolfPartialRemedy.desc: This remedy can heal lycanthropy in subjects who have not yet transformed.

WerewolfRemedy.name: Lycanthropic Remedy
WerewolfRemedy.desc: Based on the work of Count Adr Hosberg and derived from the original lycanthrope's heart, this remedy is the only way to heal patients afflicted with lycanthropy.

line0.t: ::roaming:: is responsible for countless cattle thefts in the area. The outraged farmers have decided to raise money in order to put an end to these crimes.

line1.t: The recent increase in caravan raids is attributed to ::roaming::. A bounty is offered to anyone who will put an end to this nuisance.

line2.t: ::roaming:: must be stopped. The Guard seems unable to deal with the issue single-handedly.

line3.t: ::roaming:: must have inconvenienced the wrong person and now, someone is willing to pay to get rid of them.

line4.t: The Brotherhood wishes to see ::roaming:: dead. These Bandits have despoiled the merchant one time too many.

line0.t: ::roaming:: is a group of forsaken Trackers. They must be slaughtered.

line1.t: Eschewing the Trackers's doctrine, this group has become a danger for Harag.

line0.t: ::roaming:: is a group of Inquisitors who turned away from the Eye's precepts. They must die.

line1.t: This group of fanatics hunts down and burns innocents. They are a threat for the entire region.

line0.t: ::roaming:: embodies something the Brotherhood punishes harshly: treason.

line1.t: There is nothing worse than former Brothers who broke their oath. Hunt them down and kill them.

line0.t: ::roaming:: is spreading death and chaos in the waters of Belerion. The Guard is requesting help.

line1.t: Gosenberg Merchants are willing to pay to have ::roaming:: eliminated.

line2.t: ::roaming:: has escaped from the Belerian Prison and intends to take vengeance on the Guard. These pirates must be stopped.

line3.t: A number of pirate captains have chipped in to offer a reward to anyone who can get rid of ::roaming::.

line0.t: ::roaming:: has escaped the Guard and is continuing their reign of terror in Ormance. Someone has to stop them.

line1.t: ::roaming:: has refused to leave Ormance and continues to brutally pillage the County. The Lord Mayor of Lycia is offering a reward to whomever can take them out.

line2.t: Despite having supposedly converted to the religion of the Light, ::roaming:: was recently seen pillaging a church. The Inquisition has called for their elimination.

line3.t: Though isolated, ::roaming:: has not abandoned their quest to conquer Ormance. The Guard wants someone to disabuse them of their illusions... for good.

line0.t: ::unit:: must be neutralised. A bonus will be paid if the target is delivered to ::place::.

line1.t: The Guard is looking for ::unit::. The target can be brought back dead or alive.

line0.desc: Neutralise ::unit::.

line1.desc: Deliver ::unit:: to the ::place::.

line0.t: ::roaming:: has some interesting information. ::unit:: must be captured and interrogated.

line1.t: ::roaming:: seems to be quite important in the region. A ransom is being offered for ::unit::'s capture.

line0.desc: Capture ::unit::.

line1.desc: Deliver ::unit:: to the Lair.

line0.t: ::roaming:: is earning the loyalty of Edoran's worst hoodlums by freeing them from the Guard's custody. This has got to stop!

line1.t: As long as ::roaming:: keeps attacking prisoner convoys, any effort to arrest Isandrin's criminals will be in vain. Someone must stop them from causing any more damage.

line2.t: The Legion is outraged! For every hoodlum they arrest, ::roaming:: sets three more of them free! Those troublemakers must die!

line0.t: ::roaming:: is setting fire to the businesses and homes of anyone who gets in their way. Someone's got to stop them!

line1.t: ::roaming:: set fire to the wrong business! Its owner has put an attractive bounty on their heads.

line2.t: The Legion suspects that ::roaming:: is hiding somewhere in the city. Those arsonists likely won't stay out of sight for long…

line0.t: ::roaming:: is setting traps for Merchants all over the County of Lombelle! The Brotherhood is calling on local Mercenaries for help.

line1.t: Three caravans have disappeared this week alone. The surviving Merchants blame ::roaming::.

line2.t: Where is ::roaming:: getting all that silk fabric and wood they've been selling? The Guard will pay anyone who can catch them stealing!

line0.t: ::roaming::’s overzealous behaviour is not good for business, and the Smugglers want them out of the picture... for good.

line1.t: The Bandits’ leader seeks revenge against those who put her behind bars: ::roaming::.

line2.t: ::roaming:: is a bit too eager to monitor the roads, which is very unfortunate for the Bandits’ dealings in the area. This must stop now.

line3.t: The deserters want their former comrades from ::roaming:: to forget about them. Once and for all.

line0.t: ::place:: is well guarded, but the Troop will be paid handsomely to destroy it.

line1.t: The Guard is convinced that hoodlums are hiding in ::place::. A handsome reward has been offered to those who will lay waste to the place.

line0.t: Word has it that a caravan packed with riches will be arriving at ::place::. Find it, rob it and kill ::unit::.

line1.t: A caravan bound for the ::place:: has already eluded us a number of times. Put a stop to their activities and kill ::unit::.

line0.t: A caravan set to arrive at ::place:: is part of a much larger group. Intercept it and capture ::unit:: for interrogation.

line1.t: We've got information about a caravan making repeated trips to a warehouse. It's supposedly on its way towards the ::place:: now. Capture ::unit:: so we can locate the warehouse.

line0.desc: Capture ::unit::.

line1.desc: Deliver ::unit:: to the Lair.

line0.t: Meet up with ::roaming:: and protect them until they reach their destination. They are ready to pay to reach safety.

line1.t: ::roaming:: is looking for mercenaries to escort them on their journey.

line0.t: Prisoner convoys seem to be headed for ::place::. Intercept them and liberate at least ::amount:: prisoners.
Find and kill $ChampionName. This individual is dangerous. Their mere existence is a threat to the population.

line1.t: Find and kill $ChampionName. This fearsome individual has already attacked many an innocent.

line0.t: Supply ::place:: with ::item:: x::amount:: and the Troop will be rewarded handsomely.

line1.t: ::place:: is desperately looking for x::amount:: of ::item:: and is ready to pay the price.

line0.desc: Sell: ::item:: x::amount::.

line0.t: Bring this message to the Informant in ::place::.

line0.desc: Bring the message to the requested location..

line0.t: The ::groupType:: have invaded ::place:: and made it their lair. The client will let the Troop keep whatever they find there.

line1.t: ::place:: no longer safe since the ::groupType:: have taken up residence there: it is high time we kicked them out.

line0.t: A Rat Infestation is destroying our lands. At night, we can hear piercing screeches coming from teeming masses.
Rumour has it that there is an unexplored Tomb of the Ancients in the region.
Bandits stole some of the citizens' belongings and dropped their precious loot while fleeing. Collect the ::item:: lost in the area.
Foreigners were seen in Alazar. Locals are asking the Troop to capture some of them and take them to the tavern.

[XX] Our group is doing really well already, so just imagine what we could do with an additional member!
[XX] All those people locked up behind bars... They deserve a second chance – and Mercenary life is just the thing!
[XX] It's actually quite handy having this prisoner with us. We can order him around however we like! We just need to make sure he doesn't escape...
[XX] We've been hauling these goods around for days. It's about time we got some return on our investment...
[XX] This old camping gear deserves to be put to better use. I can't stand seeing it used under these conditions.
[XX] It's stressful going around with stolen items, but I reckon that with enough time and a bit of elbow grease...
[XX] Our gang deserves to be better known. We've got to make a name for ourselves, whatever it takes!
[XX] Mercenary life isn't easy, but I like spending time with ::name::. If only we could get to know each other a little better...
[XX] It's a rough world out there, but we still manage to enjoy life on our own terms. I hope it'll stay that way for a long time!
[XX] I can't go on watching my mates die. I won't let it happen again! Not on my watch!
[XX] I feel like we tend to forget that we're actually Mercenaries. A new contract would get the troop back on track, and fill our pockets at the same time.
[XX] An alcoholic? Me? No one's called me that in a long time... Ah well, what's one little drink? But this is the last time, I swear.
[XX] Ever since I first tried human meat, I can't stop thinking about it. That rich aroma of grilled pork... That melt-in-your-mouth taste... Maybe we could have it again sometime?
[XX] I'm so glad I learned to fish. It's a great way to catch my breath for a bit between all the fighting. I wouldn't mind a bit of fishing right now, actually...
[XX] We've been running low on raw materials lately. We should head back to the mines, to make sure we're ready for whatever may come.
[XX] We're short on wood. We should probably stock up now so we don't run out when we need it most.
[XX] A good blacksmith keeps the flames of his talent burning hot.
[XX] If you know how to read them, the forest's full of tracks and trails, which can lead to some prey that's just waiting to be hunted.
[XX] People think that putting a lock on their most precious possessions is enough to protect them. I'd like to show those fools how wrong they are.
[XX] We've fought a lot of animals to collect these fangs, and I think it's time we traded them with the Trackers for a nice reward.
[XX] I like my life as a Mercenary, but... I miss my home village. I'd like to make a quick trip back there, just to see how everyone's doing.
[XX] There's not much in this world that's worse than those nightmarish creatures. It's our duty as fighters to face that ghostly threat head-on.
[XX] What better way to relax after battle than a friendly bit of sport? Let's go kick the ball around!
[XX] Fighting wolves and Bandits is all well and good, but I want to see how we stack up against the best of the best!
[XX] I can't stand to even look at that half-wit any more. Next chance I get, I swear I'll hit him so hard, his grandchildren will feel it!
[XX] I can tell our troop's got great potential! We've got what it takes to go toe-to-toe with the best! I'm sure our next fight will be a breeze.
[XX] Once you've chosen a life of crime, it's hard to change paths... Might as well enjoy the advantages. Stealing from Merchants won't change our situation much...
[XX] I can't take it any more. All this stuff weighing me down all the time... and I'm supposed to fight this way, too? Couldn't we just buy a new pony?
[XX] Our team composition is good, but not perfect. I think we'd benefit from hiring someone to fill one of our gaps.
[XX] Let's be honest: every injured member of the troop slows us down massively. We can't seriously try to keep going without first aid.
[XX] Our equipment is constantly breaking. We'd be better off having some repair materials with us.
[XX] This training dummy intrigues me. There are a few attack moves I'd like to try out on it.
[XX] I can't take any more of these disgusting “vegetable” dishes. Give me some real meat, or I'll end up eating one of you!
[XM] I'm happy with my work, but I'd like to improve a bit, just in case I ever leave some day.

line1.text: [XF] I'm happy with my work, but I'd like to improve a bit, just in case I ever leave some day.

line0.text: [XX] These antiques are pretty and all, but they take up a lot of space. Other than selling them, what are they even good for?
[XX] These tablets are just begging to be translated. They've really piqued my curiosity. What secrets do they hold?
[XX] Just looking at these ingredients makes my mouth water. I'll bet we could make something delicious from all this...
[XX] This region is overflowing with resources just waiting to be tasted. Let's gather a few and try them out!
[FX]Today is the first time since our wedding that I don't feel like strangling Gunbald. Maybe that means it's time to bury the hatchet?
[XX]Agree to reconcile with Gunbald
[XX]Refuse to forgive the idiot
[MX]Saint Eleor curse me, it's happening again! I can't get Heleth out of my head. I know our marriage is over, but I can't stop thinking about her. Should we give it a second try?
[XX]Ask Heleth to marry you again
[XX]Refuse to go through the same disaster a second time

[FX]Finally! That degenerate Gunbald is finally dead!
By Saint Eleor, this is the best day of my life!
[XX]Celebrate the death of your sworn enemy

[MX]I can't believe it! It's finally happened! Heleth has kicked the bucket!
Saint Jeru be praised for letting me witness this day!
[XX]Celebrate the death of your sworn enemy

[FX]Seeing my house again has brought my old life flooding back.
Was I right to give up on it? Should I have tried to rebuild it?
If I talk to the others about this, they'll think I'm an ingrate…
[XX]Ignore your doubts and accept your fate as a Mercenary
[XX]Leave the group and go home to Arthes

[FX]Corpse robber! Ugh! I had so little ambition before!
Now I earn in three days what I used to take months to save up… and I don't smell like rotting flesh anymore! The Mercenary life is the only way to live. I couldn't have chosen a better career.
[XX]Celebrate your excellent choice of career with your comrades
[XX]Celebrate the fact that you're no longer just a pillager

[FX]All this laughter and applause… The Skelmar never had this much fun! I think I've finally found my vocation in life. Aeda put me on this earth to be a bard! Now let's think about how to put my talent to use…
[XX]Use your gift to entertain the Camp
[XX]Use your gift to motivate the troops
[MX]These Mercenaries are less barbaric than I thought. After the way they defended those innocent people from the outlaws, I'd even say I have real respect for them.
[XX]Declare your high esteem for the members of the troop
[XX]Become a full-fledged member of the troop
[MX]Mercenary work is terrible! I almost died from the sheer pain of this injury! I would rather have been sold into slavery!
[MX]Curl up into a ball and cry
[MX]Brood about your misfortune
[MX]Run as fast as you can to leave the troop behind for good
[MX]I've changed a lot since the Mercenaries saved me. Even my own sister wouldn't recognise me. She always thought I was an incompetent fool… She'd be amazed to see the man I've become.
[MX]Look back with pride at your progress
[MX]Send a letter to Gosenberg to taunt Malvina Ald Hoevendorp

[FX]Delivering a heretic to the Light's judgement is such an honour. Praised be Saint Jeru for having granted it to me!
May his wisdom enlighten my Companions! May they capture the heathens with great zeal!
[FX]Praise Saint Jeru for his kindness
[FX]Encourage the Companions to hunt down the heretics

[FX]I… I've killed an Inquisitor!
How could I attack my own brother? I've condemned my soul to wander for eternity! The Eye's Reckoning is sure to come down upon me. I'm nothing but a miserable heretic!
[FX]Convince yourself that these Inquisitors were not true believers
[FX]Renounce your faith rather than live as a hypocrite
[FX]Leave this troop of heretics to join the Inquisition

[MX]Slaughtering bandits doesn't bother me one bit! Better them than me!
Even so, I have to believe that if Matthias Lund hadn't found me, this troop would've cut my throat!
[MX]Appreciate your good luck
[MX]Feel satisfied with your new life
[MX]And here I thought Mercenaries were on the right side of the law! I've known murderers more honest than this lot! Like my mother always said, birds of a feather flock together!
[MX] Celebrate the group's crimes
[MX]Be happy to have Companions as dishonest as yourself

[MX]This rats' nest won't infect anyone else again! We've done our duty!
As Saint Jeru is my witness, I won't let the misfortune that befell me destroy other families!
[MX]Swear to eradicate the Plague from the Five Kingdoms
[MX]Express your gratitude to the troop for helping you get revenge

[FX]My clan would be so proud of me – I've been travelling with the Mercenaries for weeks, and I haven't challenged a single order! Even the really stupid ones!
I've got to keep this up. I swore an oath!
[FX]Renew your promise and keep it
[FX]Feel pleased with your efforts

[MX]I never should have drunk that remedy! By Saint Jeru, why'd they make me drink it?
Now all I can think of is Roselind! I miss her so much! I was happier when I was a monster!
[MX]Grieve
[MX]Turn your sorrow into hatred

[FX] One bottle. Two bottles... No matter how much I drink, I can't get rid of that damn taste. It's the taste of betrayal!
How could my own crew have sold me to the Guard? It was my right not to share. They knew what they were getting into when they boarded my ship!
[FX]Help Esma to remember who she was.
[FX]Fuel her rage with even more alcohol

[FX] I think about my old companions every night. I hear their voices, their laughter... If this troop hadn't shown up in time...
Sometimes I wonder if I was really saved, or doomed to remember what I've lost.
[FX]Swear to never let another Companion die
[FX]Draw on your brutal experience to help your new Companions

[MX] May the Tules curse me if I ever hunt treasure again! After those damn pigs, I’ve no interest anymore...
Bah! We were so close to Captain Esma’s treasure!
[MX]Swear to never risk your life for a treasure again.
[MX]Tell your Companions about Captain Esma's fabulous treasure.

[MX] I'm travelling with Captain Esma herself! And I think she likes me!
Oh! By the saints! If only I'd gone out hunting for her instead of her treasure! A legend like her would never have left me to the peasants!
[MX]Promise Captain Esma that you'll be a worthy second-in-command.
[MX]Swear to Captain Esma that you'll be worthy of her affection.

[MX] Why didn't Igor want me in the prison? He took any old pleb who crossed his path, but not me. It's the same with our enemies! I haven't got the slightest wound! No concussion! Not even a minor scrape...
[MX]Conclude that no one will ever pay you any attention
[MX]Accept your fate

[MX] They're applauding! These idiots are applauding me! I'm singing the most ridiculous songs of my career, and they applaud!
Oh Saint Lenaid, my art has become so devoid of meaning that I can feel my soul crumbling under the sheer stupidity of my Companions!
[MX]Embrace a career as a popular juggler.
[MX]Add scandalous lyrics to your songs

[FM]::name:: is dead…! Not again!
My company will be decimated, they'll all be killed off one by one, and I'll end up mopping floors in some filthy Tavern again.
Oh! By all the saints! Don't let this be my fate!

line1.text:
[FF]::name:: is dead…! Not again!
My company will be decimated, they'll all be killed off one by one, and I'll end up mopping floors in some filthy Tavern again.
Oh! By all the saints! Don't let this be my fate!

line0.text: [FX]Swear not to let another Companion die
[FX]Start preparing to change to a new career
[XX]Sure, she ruined the vintners in Vertruse and kidnapped Clemens Ald Marheim's betrothed, but letting Brunhilde escape was the right thing to do. Now Alazar is indebted to the troop!
[XX]Drink to Alazar's health and their bounty
[XX]Learn your lessons from this adventure and get ready for the next one

[XX]Saving a Broker's betrothed from the clutches of an Alazarian princess! It's the kind of thing bards write songs about!
Glory to us, plus plenty of good Gosenberg wine. I'll bet next year's vintage will be named after us!
[XX]Drink to the happy Ald Marheim couple's health
[XX]Learn your lessons from this adventure and get ready for the next one

[XX]Such a sad end for Godrik Ald Bernna. He seemed like a good bloke, aside from the fact that he paid those assassins to kill his rival.
Too bad we had to choose between him and the bounty.
[XX]Pay your last respects to the murderous Broker
[XX]Enjoy some good Gosenberg wine and the bounty

[XX]Laheart is the rightful Count of Arthes. It's only right that he defeated his rival, and I'm proud to have fought by his side. Our prestige in the Edoranian General's eyes can only increase as a result.
[XX]Celebrate the victory of the rightful Count of Arthes
[XX]Learn your lessons from this adventure and get ready for the next one
[XX]We were simply following Saint Jeru's will by helping Lord Vernalis. The Inquisition and the Church of the Light will surely be most grateful to us.
[XX]Celebrate the victory of Saint Jeru's chosen one
[XX]Give thanks to the God of Light for this victory

[XX]Whoever the General puts in charge of this County, they can't be worse than Vernalis and Laheart! It's a good thing the troops refused to take sides, or I wouldn't be able to look at myself in the mirror!
[XX]Celebrate the death of the two despots
[XX]Talk with the troop about the future Count

[XX]And here I thought the Inquisition were only good for burning farmers! It's a good thing they were there!
Any longer and Alazar would have reduced their own kingdom to ashes! How could those heretics think they could control the God of Light?
[XX]Celebrate the Inquisition's victory over Alazar
[XX]Pray together to the God of Light
[XX]Once Prince Aerald is able to control the Eye's Reckoning, he'll be the most powerful man in the Five Kingdoms. Then we'll be happy we sided with him instead of his enemies!
[XX]Celebrate the victory of Knowledge over fanaticism
[XX]Take pride in having clearly chosen the winning side

[XX]I can't sleep at night! All I see when I close my eyes is the Beast's bloodthirsty grin!
I don't know what the Scholars may have learnt from those relics, but nothing justifies bringing that monster down on the residents of Ludern!
[XX]Celebrate the defeat of the Alazarian Scholars
[XX]Thank the Tules and the Ancients for granting this victory
[XX]Alazar's methods may be extreme, but fanaticism needs to be countered! If the relics of the Ancients can help to advance Knowledge, what right does Harag have to keep them locked up in a Tomb?
[XX]Celebrate the victory of Knowledge over obscurantism
[XX]Learn your lessons from this adventure and get ready for the next one

[XX]I hope I'll live long enough to tell my grandchildren about our adventures in Belerion! We learned to sail, met the descendant of the emperors of Edoran, fought pirates and defeated the Sea Serpent. Damn! If I'd known all that was coming when we delivered wood to the carpenter in Tiltren…
[XX]Celebrate the end of your travels in the Archipelago
[XX]Give thanks to the Gods of Ihraa for this adventure

[XX]Did we do the right thing when we left Sigurdr in charge of Ormance? He turned out to be a more reliable ally than expected, but I still can't get Liv's words out of my head. Can a Skelmar really be content with just one County?
[XX]Set your doubts aside and celebrate the victory over the Skelmar
[XX]Head out to new adventures without looking back

[XM]Now that the Skelmar have been defeated, I won't be sad to leave Ormance behind. Montrevel may be the rightful Countess, but I wonder if it would have been better to listen to Tella and let the Skelmar cut her throat in front of the prison.

line1.text: [XF]Now that the Skelmar have been defeated, I won't be sad to leave Ormance behind. Montrevel may be the rightful Countess, but I wonder if it would have been better to listen to Tella and let the Skelmar cut her throat in front of the prison.

line0.text: [XX]Celebrate the Skelmar's victory and ignore the Countess
[XX]Head out to new adventures without looking back

[XX]After all that the people of Ormance did to free themselves from the Skelmar, they deserved the chance to choose their own Count! I hope that Tella and the Lord Mayor will still be there to protect the farmers once we're gone.
[XX]Drink to the glory of the people of Ormance
[XX]Confess your fears to the group about the fate of Ormance
[MX]Well! Who would have thought we'd see Countess Montrevel and Sigurdr laying siege to Forecastle Rock, hand in hand! Some people didn't waste any time whilst we were liberating the baronies!

line1.text: [FX]Well! Who would have thought we'd see Countess Montrevel and Sigurdr laying siege to Forecastle Rock, hand in hand! Some people didn't waste any time whilst we were liberating the baronies!

line0.text: [XX]Drink to the liberation of Ormance County and to its new rulers
[XX]Bet on the longevity of Montrevel and Sigurdr's union

[XX]That last battle left a bad taste in my mouth… I would've hoped for a better fate for Tiltren.
If only its inhabitants had been a bit more charitable!
[XX]Suggest that the group share a drink to forget the sad events in Tiltren
[XX]Encourage the group to toughen up and stop moping
[XX]It's too late for regrets – Tiltren's inhabitants and refugees made their choice long before we came along. The Mercenaries can only decide who they support.
[XX]Push this unfortunate ending out of your mind
[XX]Remind the group of their place as Mercenaries

[XX]Oh! By the gods, it's finally over! The Knights have their remedy!
Let's take our bounty and get out of here. I never want to set foot in the Weald again as long as I live!
[XX]Celebrate the troop's departure for a more hospitable region
[XX]Learn your lessons from this adventure and get ready for the next one

TroopAdventurers.introText:
The Companions are off in search of adventure!
After a few days of quietly travelling along, their only feat was not getting lost and they have reached their destination.
Here, surely, awaits some novel and exciting quest that will stir up the uneventful lives of bored apprentices!
Adventure awaits at the end of the road! For those who make it there alive, that is...

TroopMerchants.introText:
A Mercenary's life is never easy...
After a heated skirmish with Bandits, the most opportunistic of the Companions have fled, leaving behind a generous payment and a furious client...
Keen to make a few Krowns, but not at the expense of their own lives, they now need to find a new job...
Repairs and drinks won't pay for themselves, after all!

TroopDeserters.introText:
Enough is enough!
After bearing that horrible captain's abuse for far too long, the Companions can finally enjoy their well-deserved freedom.
Although...
Deserters are never appreciated, neither by their former colleagues nor by the locals, who regard them as traitors for some reason.
They will need to keep their heads down, while still making a living.

TroopFarmers.desc: Farmers looking for a better life
TroopFarmers.introText:
Ah, the fresh scent of the morning breeze filled with the delicate tang of the nearby stables…
A good old-fashioned Tavern brawl, where the furnishings make for perfect weapons…
Born and raised in the countryside, the Companions know the value of the simpler things in life.
But to make it in this world, one must take risks and go far afield in search of fame and fortune!
Just be careful not to lose what they value most along the way… That is to say, the shoes.

TroopBandits.desc: Bandits looking to escape the Guard
TroopBandits.introText:
It was all very straightforward…
Petty theft, highway robberies, a purse of coins handed to a childhood friend now serving in the Guard, and the Companions always got off scot-free.
The simple honest life of a merry gang of Bandits.
But there's always that one last score… The one that targets the wrong person... The victim who is out for revenge...
After running away in a very disorderly fashion, the Troop has reached a new region.
Surely, here they will find many new opportunities to get rich quickly! After all, one person's loss is another one's gain...

TroopPugilist.introText:
At least the Companions are still alive!
That's more than they expected when the storm sank their ship, along with their dreams of piracy on the high seas.
Now stuck on dry land, they've got all the time in the world to discover the joys of day-long hikes, wild beast attacks, hostile villagers, and more!
But sailors are a resourceful lot. In time, they're sure to adapt and thrive!
TroopPugilist.props.unlockConditions:
Requires one of the following:
- Must have a Punchman of level 5 or higher
- Must complete the story for a region
- Must complete a contract in a region other than Tiltren

TroopTavern.desc: Associates willing to set up their Tavern
TroopTavern.introText:
Their Tavern will be the most famous in all the Five Kingdoms!
The Companions are confident that with their innate talent for cooking and their love of fine drink, they've got what it takes to open the business they've always dreamed of.
Who cares that they don't know where the nearest village is and have only mastered two or three recipes? Becoming tavern keepers is their true calling!

TroopCrossbow.introText:
After years of loyal service to the Edoranian Legion, it was eventually decided that the Companions' time had come.
Forced into retirement and sent back to their homes, these hardened soldiers don't intend to fade away quietly in their old age.
They've decided to embark on a whole new adventure, filled with challenges and discoveries, and to show all those youngsters that the older the fiddler, the sweeter the tune!
TroopCrossbow.props.unlockConditions:
Requires one of the following:
- Must have a Crossbowman of level 5 or higher
- Must complete the story for a region
- Must complete a contract in a region other than Tiltren

TroopTrapper.desc: Hunters on the lookout for new prey
TroopTrapper.introText:
For years, the Companions were the pride of their village. Their hunting skills guaranteed them a peaceful and prosperous life. However, deep down, they knew that beyond the horizon, prey far more worthy of their talents lay in wait.
So one morning, they packed their few belongings and left their families behind in search of much bigger game...
The kind that walks on two legs and has a large price on its head.
TroopTrapper.props.unlockConditions:
Requires one of the following:
- Must have a Huntsman of Experienced rank or higher
- Must complete the story for a region
- Must complete a contract in a region other than Tiltren

TroopFief.desc: Nobles driven from their own lands
TroopFief.introText:
The minor nobles, devastated by the war in Ormance, left their native lands in search of a new beginning and ... new properties.
Having changed several regions, they are determined to establish themselves in these lands and seize by force the riches that they deserve.

TroopCenser.introText:
Knowledge isn't learnt from books, but in the field! It's this deep belief that led the Companions to leave their libraries behind and strike out on the road, hungry for learning and curious about everything.
Determined to surpass Alazar's greatest professors, the Scholars have become Mercenaries and intend to unravel the Five Kingdom's many mysteries themselves. And it's nothing to do with the fact that all the Universities have rejected them!
TroopCenser.props.unlockConditions:
Requires one of the following:
- Have a Crossbowman of level 5 or higher.
- Finish a region's scenario.
- Complete a contract in a region other than Tiltren.

TroopOrphans.desc: City-dwellers with an appetite for travel
TroopOrphans.introText:
The Companions are quite familiar with big cities... too familiar, in fact!
They grew up as street urchins, many of them orphans, in the roughest back alleys of Isandrin and Gosenberg. Now, these tough, street-smart lads are ready to discover the world beyond the city walls and experience a life of adventure under the open sky.
And really, how hard could it be to start a campfire?

Bonus6.desc: ... have a gift for petty theft

Bonus8.desc: ... enjoy being at one with nature

Bonus13.desc: ... know what they want in this world

Bonus14.desc: ... know how to get a good deal

Malus4.desc: ... a very hard time getting up

Malus6.desc: ... a greediness far more developed than others

Malus7.desc: ... a very relative sense of loyalty

Malus9.desc: ... an attitude that does not inspire trust

Malus10.desc: ... a lack of motivation in manual labour

Malus11.desc: ... a trouble keeping a fire going

Alcoholic.desc: Happiness -1, if there is no alcohol in the diet. [CritHitPercent] +1%.

Glorious.desc: Chance to generate <apt>1</apt> at the end of their turn.

When a two-handed weapon is equipped:
[Strength] <good>+5%</good>,
[Dexterity] <good>+5%</good>.

Vivid.desc:
When a one-handed weapon is equipped:
[Strength] <good>+5%</good>,
[Dexterity] <good>+5%</good>.

EyesBack.name: Eyes on the back of the Head
EyesBack.desc:
Cannot be hit by allied arrows.
[Dexterity] <good>+3%</good>.

Enduring.name: Tough
Enduring.desc: Has a chance to avoid injuries in combat.

Instinctive.name: Instinctive
Instinctive.desc: Chance of taking a critical hit <good>–::value::%</good>.

Brave.name: Brave
Brave.desc:
If outnumbered at the beginning of a battle:
[Strength] <good>+5%</good>,
[Dexterity] <good>+5%</good>.

Humanist.name: Altruistic
Humanist.desc:
Increases the chance of recruiting a nearby prisoner.
[Willpower] <good>+1</good>.

Tyrannical.name: Tyrannical
Tyrannical.desc:
If there are prisoners in the camp:
[Willpower] <good>+3</good>.

Masochist.name: Masochist
Masochist.desc: If injured by a whip during a Rest: Happiness +::value::.

When in the Tombs of the Ancients:
[Willpower] <bad>-5</bad>.

Delicate.name: Delicate

Maniac.desc:
When their equipment is not repaired:
[Willpower] <bad>-5</bad>.

Megalomaniac.name: Megalomaniac

[Willpower] <bad>-5</bad>.

Allergic.name: Allergic
Allergic.desc: Doubles the effects of a Sting injury.

Grumpy.name: Quarrelsome
Grumpy.desc:
Increased risk of not getting along with their peers.

[Dexterity] <good>+1</good>.

[Dexterity] <good>+3</good>.

Camaraderie.name: Comrade
Camaraderie.desc: Chance to get [AnimalMarkedBonus] if an ally they share a positive relationship with is dying nearby.

Savior.name: Saviour
Savior.desc:
For each nearby ally with lesser [CurHP]:
[Strength] <good>+5%</good>,
[Dexterity] <good>+5%</good>.

ImaginativeTinker.name: Crafty Tinkerer
ImaginativeTinker.desc: Once a day, when the Companion crafts an item in the workshop, they have a ::value::% chance to get a random component.

Addict.name: Addicted
Addict.desc: This character is addicted to medicinal drugs: Happiness ::value::, if they do not sleep on the stretcher during a Rest.

BrightSmile.name: Bright Smile
BrightSmile.desc: Every time this Companion engages in combat, there is a ::value::% chance to apply [Blind] to the engaged enemy.

NimbleFoot.name: Fleet of Foot
NimbleFoot.desc: Cannot be affected by [Slowdown] or have their movement reduced by [Mud] or [Caltrops].

HeavySleep.name: Heavy Sleeper
HeavySleep.desc:
Does not reduce chances to escape of nearby prisoners.
[Willpower] <good>+1</good>.

Snorer.name: Snorer
Snorer.desc:
Increases the risk of not getting along with nearby colleagues during a Rest.
[GIcon] <good>+2%</good>.

Carnivorous.name: Carnivorous
Carnivorous.desc: Happiness -1, if there is nor meat nor fish in the diet. [CritHitPercent] +1%. The trait cannot be removed.

Vegetarian.name: Vegetarian
Vegetarian.desc: Happiness -1, if there are nor fruits nor vegetables in the diet. [Movement] +1. The trait cannot be removed.

Lone.name: Solitary
Lone.desc:
If not next to an ally in combat:
[DamageBonusPercent] <good>+7%</good>.

Cooperative.name: Cooperative
Cooperative.desc:

Sommelier.desc: Happiness +1, if there is alcohol in the diet.

EnemyBurned.name: Mortal Enemy

Watched the Inquisition burning their enemy at the stake.
[Willpower] <good>+3</good>.

Immune to the effects of civilians' environmental attacks.

ArenaMaster.desc: [DamageBonusPercent] is increased when this unit is in an arena fight.

[Willpower] <good>+::value::</good>.

TavernSleeper.name: Pampered Tastes
TavernSleeper.desc: Gains <status>[WellRested]</status> when sleeping in a tavern.

HelethEnemy.name: Heleth's Enemy
HelethEnemy.desc: This character hates Heleth, and nothing can improve their relationship.

GunbaldEnemy.name: Gunbald's Enemy
GunbaldEnemy.desc: This character hates Gunbald, and nothing can improve their relationship.

HelethSoulmate.name: Heleth's Soulmate

This character has joined their fate to Heleth's, for better or worse.

GunbaldSoulmate.name: Gunbald's Soulmate

This character has joined their fate to Gunbald's, for better or worse.
Gains <status>[Fury]</status> when Gunbald is wounded by an enemy.

FreeFromHeleth.name: Heleth's Ex

After putting up with Heleth for years, this character is now free of her insufferable presence.
[Willpower] <good>+2</good>.

FreeFromGunbald.name: Gunbald's Ex
FreeFromGunbald.desc:
After putting up with Gunbald for years, this character is now free of his insufferable presence.
[Willpower] <good>+2</good>.

RogueApothecary.name: Wandering Witch
RogueApothecary.desc:
Who said a witch cannot be a Mercenary?!
The <skill>FirstAid</skill> skill is ::value::% more effective.

BardBorn.name: Natural-Born Bard
BardBorn.desc: This character's music enchants hearts and minds alike. Happiness +::value:: during a Rest, if the character is assigned to the lute.

WarBard.name: Bard of War
WarBard.desc: This character's music fills their listeners' hearts with courage. Generates ::value:: during a Rest, if the character is assigned to the lute

PeopleProtector.name: People's Protector
PeopleProtector.desc:
This character chose to give up their career as a captain in the Legion and dedicate their life to protecting the people.
Each time the characters engages an Outlaw in combat: <apt>+1</apt>.

SonOfTrader.name: Broker's Son
SonOfTrader.desc: Despite all the adventures he's experienced, this character has kept the manners of a wealthy heir. Gained from missions +::value::%.

FormerIncompetent.name: Former Good-for-Nothing
FormerIncompetent.desc: Countless challenges have turned this character into a valiant Mercenary. Gained Experience +::value::%.

Orthodoxe.name: Orthodox Believer
Orthodoxe.desc:
This character can tell a true believer from a despicable heretic.
Critical hit is guaranteed, if a target has [IconBurning].

Apostat.name: Apostate
Apostat.desc:
This character preferred to renounce their faith rather than betray it.
Has a ::value::% chance of losing [IconBurning] at the start of each turn in combat.
[Movement] <good>+2</good>.

LuckyBandit.name: Lucky Devil
LuckyBandit.desc:
This character should have come to a tragic end, but miraculously survived.
Does not suffer injuries when retreating.
[Movement] <good>+2</good>.

ReformedCharacter.name: Reformed Criminal
ReformedCharacter.desc:
Abandoning their life as a Bandit for a career as a Mercenary, this character hunts their former colleagues without remorse.
Rewards for delivering an Outlaw to a prison <good>+::value::%</good>.

PeopleHero.name: Hero of the People
PeopleHero.desc:
This character found new meaning in life by swearing to protect the people from the Plague.
Improves the relationship with a Companion when a rats' nest is destroyed.
[Willpower] <good>+2</good>.

MasterExterminator.name: Chief Exterminator
MasterExterminator.desc: It's decided! From now on, this character will dedicate their life to exterminating rats. Gained Experience +::value::%, when a rats' nest is destroyed.

DisciplinedTracker.name: Disciplined Tracker
DisciplinedTracker.desc:
There's surely no more obedient and disciplined Tracker in all the Five Kingdoms than this character.
The first time the Companion uses a skill that costs Valour, the Troop gains <ap>::value::</ap>.

Trustworthy.name: Trustworthy
Trustworthy.desc:
If there's one Companion whose loyalty is beyond all doubt, it's got to be this character.
Cannot injure Companions with a [PrecisionBonus] skill.

SisbertBereaved.name: Bereaved
SisbertBereaved.desc: Happiness -1 during Rest. If Happiness is too low, generates ::ap::.

BaneOfSeas.name: Scourge of the Seas

DeadDrunk.name: Liquid Courage

Protector.name: Protector

EsmaSecond.desc: Gains [Fury] when Esma takes damage whilst adjacent to this unit.

EsmaDamnedSoul.name: Esma's Soulmate

Invisible.name: Trickster

PopularSinger.name: Popular Singer

Bitter.name: Vicious

Alchemist.name: Alchemist
Alchemist.desc: Can learn recipes and brew concoctions using the Apothecary Table.

Thief.name: Thief
Thief.desc: Can steal items and pick locks.
Thief.props.tavern.desc: Thieves blend in with patrons to rob them and generate revenue. However, they occupy a seat and reduce Security.

Cook.name: Cook
Cook.desc: Can learn recipes and prepare meals using the Cooking pot.
Cook.props.tavern.desc: The Scullion can produce meals if they are assigned to the oven. They cook to order based on how many customers come in.

Tinkerer.name: Tinkerer
Tinkerer.desc: Can learn recipes, and craft and enhance Camping gear using the Workshop.

Scholar.name: Scholar
Scholar.desc: Can decipher codices and piece together Antiquities using the Lectern.

Bard.name: Bard
Bard.desc: Can learn songs and sing them in taverns.
Bard.props.tavern.desc: The Bard is assigned to the lute. The Bard increases Comfort, as well as sale odds in the surrounding area. Different song selections will attract different types of patrons.

Brewer.name: Vintner
Brewer.desc: Can learn recipes and make alcohol at the camp Brewing Vat.
Brewer.props.tavern.desc: Vintners can produce or age alcohol when assigned to a barrel. They work independently of sales, and their output can be stored.

Trapper.name: Huntsman
Trapper.desc: Can produce more game from burrows and examine traces left by animals.

Pilot.name: Helmsman
Pilot.desc: Handles the helm, allows to sail.

Gunner.name: Gunner
Gunner.desc: Handles the the ballista, allows to fire the ballista.

Watchman.desc: Watches the surroundings and provides information on unexplored islands or incoming enemies.

OarsmenChief.desc: Motivates the oarsmen and increases their efficiency.

CrewFisherman.desc: Automatically deploys the nets if the ship passes through a shoal of fish. If the ship leaves the shoal, the fish scatters and the angling is over.

Inkeeper.props.tavern.desc: The Tavern Keeper keeps the establishment running. Without them, the Tavern won't generate profits or spending. It will stop making progress, and the Shift report won't be published.

TavernGuard.props.tavern.desc: Bouncers stand in the Tavern and improve Security. The stronger they are in relation to the Troop average, the more effective they are.

TavernUnassigned.name: Unassigned

TavernBouncer.name: Bouncer

TavernReinforcements.name: Reinforcements

TavernSaurian.name: Exotic Curiosity

TavernMosquito.name: Buzzing
TavernMosquito.desc: Lowers Comfort by ::value::, but costs less food.

TavernRat.name: Vermin
TavernRat.desc: Reduces sale odds for all patrons in the area but costs less food.

TavernVersatility.name: Versatility

TavernButcher.name: Butcher
TavernButcher.desc: Has a ::percent:: greater chance to produce delicious simple dishes, which can be sold at a higher price.

TavernSaucier.name: Saucier
TavernSaucier.desc: Has a ::percent:: greater chance to produce delicious combined dishes, which can be sold at a higher price.

TavernChef.name: Chef
TavernChef.desc: Has a ::percent:: greater chance to produce delicious feasts, which can be sold at a higher price.

TavernEncouragement.name: Encouragement

TavernPrisoner.name: Prisoner
TavernPrisoner.desc: Lowers Prestige by ::value:: per Shift, but costs less food.

Strength.name: Strength

Determines damage of skills based on this attribute.
Additional effect during combat: 3 points of the attribute increase damage of critical attacks by 1%.

Dexterity.name: Dexterity
Dexterity.desc:
Determines damage of skills based on this attribute.
Additional effect during combat: 3 points of the attribute increase chance of an attack to be critical one by 1%.

Constitution.name: Constitution
Constitution.desc: Determines how much [MaxHP] the unit has: 1 point of the attribute is 20 points of [MaxHP]. Additional effect: 3 points of the attribute increase by 1. Also determines damage or power of certain skills.
Constitution.descAnimal: Determines how much [MaxHP] the unit has: 1 point of the attribute is 20 points of [MaxHP].

CritHitPercent.name: Mastery
CritHitPercent.desc:
Determines a chance of attacks to land a critical hit and to deal additional damage. If the damage of a skill has a range of values, then the critical damage will be the maximum of them.
Attacks from behind have a 20% higher chance to be critical.

Movement.name: Speed

Related Effects: [Destruction]: the damage is dealt directly to [CurHP], it is calculated as a percentage of [MaxHP] of the targets. [Vitality]: the damage or effectiveness of an ability is calculated as a percentage of [MaxHP] of this unit.

Deals [DMG] to the target. The damage <good>+::value1::%</good> per [IconPoison] application on the target.

RatMaster.name: Rat Master

Nepti.name: Foulness Bringer
Nepti.desc: Deals [DMG] to the target and applies [IconCorrosion]::value1:: and [IconPoison]::value1::.
