PackLeader.name: Leader of the Pack
PackLeader.desc: Gains [AnimalProtection] for each allied animal not engaged in combat.

AnimalPackLeader.name: King of Nature
AnimalPackLeader.desc: Gains [AnimalProtection] for each allied animal not engaged in combat.

BattleBrothers.name: Brothers in Arms
BattleBrothers.desc: Every time an allied animal dies, this unit gains ::value1:: [Wrath].

FeralCharge.name: Feral Charge
FeralCharge.desc: Disengages and charges in a straight line. Deals [DMG] to all the units in its path and applies [Vulnerability].

DefenseOfTheOwner.name: Defence of the Master
DefenseOfTheOwner.desc: Deals [DMG] to the target and forces them to engage.

RuthlessCharge.name: Ruthless Charge
RuthlessCharge.desc: Disengages and charges in a straight line. Deals [DMG] to all units in their path. Consumes all applications of [Retaliation] to increase the maximum charge distance. Gains [Stampede].

FerociousTusks.name: Ferocious Tusks
FerociousTusks.desc: Deals [DMG] to all units in the area, the damage <good>+::value1::%</good>for each [Retaliation] effect. Then consumes all applications of [Retaliation] and gains [Stampede].

ThickBoarSkin.name: Thick Boar Skin
ThickBoarSkin.desc: Incoming attacks deal no damage, if their damage is less than [MaxHP]::value1::%. At the end of the round, removes all applications of [IconPoison], [IconBleeding] and [IconBurning].

WildRage.name: Wild Rage
WildRage.desc: Each time this unit is hit by an attack, it gains one application of [Retaliation].

SliceAndDice.name: Slice and Dice
SliceAndDice.desc:
Deals ::value:: damage to all the units in the area.

LossOfControl.name: Loss of Control
LossOfControl.desc: Once this unit has [CurHP]::value1::% or less, they gain [Brutality] until the end of the fight.

BionnAttack.name: Hunt Strike
BionnAttack.desc:
Deals [DMG] to the target and gains ::value1:: [AnimalMarkedBonus].
Critical Hit: Gains ::value1:: [AnimalMarkedBonus].

TransformedBionnAttack.name: Plagued Claw Strike
TransformedBionnAttack.desc:
Deals [DMG] to the target, gains ::value1:: [AnimalMarkedBonus] and applies ::value2:: [IconFever].
Critical Hit: Gains ::value1:: [AnimalMarkedBonus].

IrrationalScreaming.name: Crazed Scream
IrrationalScreaming.desc: Cries out to a number of Plague-ridden reinforcements equal to their [BionnPanic]. Then removes all their applications.

DisturbedMind.name: Disturbed Mind
DisturbedMind.desc: [DamageBonusPercent] <bad>-::value1::%</bad> for each Plague-ridden unit engaged in combat.

GlimmersOfMortality.name: Glimmers of Mortality
GlimmersOfMortality.desc: Each time they take damage, this unit gains one application of [BionnPanic].

Transformation.name: Transformation
Transformation.desc: This unit transforms, once they have [CurHP]::value1::% or less.

FenrisSeek.name: Target the Weak
FenrisSeek.desc: Applies [Sentence] to the weakest enemy within range.

FenrisElimination.name: Kill the Weak
FenrisElimination.desc:
Deals [DMG] and forces the target to disengage.

FenrisFreedom.name: For Freedom!
FenrisFreedom.desc: Deals [DMG] to all units in the target area, knocks them back by ::value1:: metres and applies [IconBleeding].

FenrisCourage.name: Valiant Strength
FenrisCourage.desc: Each time this unit deals damage, gains one application of [FenrisCourage].

FenrisCourageTrigger.name: Fight or Flight
FenrisCourageTrigger.desc: At ::value1:: stacks of [FenrisCourage], this unit gains [Brutality]. When the unit has [CurHP]::value2::% or less, they decide to flee the battle.

FenrisCharge.name: I Need to Run!
FenrisCharge.desc: Disengages and charges in a straight line. Deals [DMG] to all units in its path.

FenrisFlee.name: Flee
FenrisFlee.desc: If they no longer have [FenrisCourage], the unit flees the battle. If not, he loses ::value1:: [FenrisCourage].

LightningSpin.name: Rushing Gale
LightningSpin.desc:
Deals [DMG] to all units in the area, knocking them back by ::value1:: metres.
Units that could not be knocked back all the way take <good>::value2::%</good> extra damage.

BrotherUnion.name: Brotherly Bond
BrotherUnion.desc: If the other brother is within ::value1:: metres, this unit gains [BrothersFury].

ValiantAssault.name: Valiant Assault
ValiantAssault.desc:
Deals [DMG] to the target.
If already engaged in combat with the target, this unit gains [Protection] for ::value1:: round and the Troop gains <apt>::value1::</apt>.

PowerZone.name: Power Zone
PowerZone.desc: A champion gains [PrideInfused] as long as they stay in this area.

KogoTargetPassive.name: Kogo's Relentlessness
KogoTargetPassive.desc: Dealing damage to a unit grants him [KogoTarget].

ToroTargetPassive.name: Toro's Relentlessness
ToroTargetPassive.desc: Dealing damage to a unit grants him [ToroTarget].

SoakedAxe.name: Infused Axe
SoakedAxe.desc:
Deals [DMG] to the target.
Guaranteed critical hit, if the target is [IconBurning].

IncendiaryFlaskThrowing.name: Incendiary Flask Throw
IncendiaryFlaskThrowing.desc: Deals [DMG] to all the units in the area, then creates a [Fire].

EquipedWithIncendiaryFlask.name: Equipped with Incendiary Flasks
EquipedWithIncendiaryFlask.desc: When this unit takes damage, an Incendiary Flask explodes randomly around them.

BeheditePenalty.name: Behedite’s Sanction
BeheditePenalty.desc:
Deals [DMG] to the target.
The damage <good>+::value2::%</good>, if none of the target’s allies are within ::value1:: metres.

BehediteSeal.name: Behedite’s Seal
BehediteSeal.desc: [DamageBonusPercent] <good>+::value2::%</good>, if none of the target’s allies are within ::value1:: metres.

DaganSeal.name: Dagan’s Seal
DaganSeal.desc: [DamageBonusPercent] <good>+::value1::%</good>, if the attack hits 2 or more targets.

BeheditePenalty1.name: Behedite’s Punishment
BeheditePenalty1.desc:
Deals [DMG] to the target.
Attack Stance: the damage <good>+::value2::%</good>, if none of the target’s allies are within ::value1:: metres.
Defence Stance: the damage <good>+::value2::%</good>, if the target has allies within ::value1:: metres.

Deals [DMG] to the target ::value1:: time(s).

Defence Stance: Applies [Destabilization] for ::value3:: round(s).

DaganPunishment.name: Dagan’s Punishment
DaganPunishment.desc:
Deals [DMG] to all units in the area.
If more than one unit takes damage, strikes ::value1:: more times.

DaganPunishment1.name: Dagan’s Retribution
DaganPunishment1.desc:
Deals [DMG] to the target.
If the unit's [MaxHP] is less than the target's one, strikes ::value1:: more times.

GluckStiffingAttack.name: Crippling Blow
GluckStiffingAttack.desc: Deals [DMG] to the target and applies [IconPoison]::value1::, as well as [Slowdown] and [NoReflexes_Fixed] for ::value2:: rounds.

GluckTraitorSwap.desc: Every time this unit deals damage while engaged, they trade places with a non-engaged ally within ::value1:: metres. The ally then becomes engaged in combat and takes an attack of opportunity. If no ally is within range, trades places with the engaged enemy.

GluckUnlimitedDodge.name: Untouchable
GluckUnlimitedDodge.desc: This unit has permanent [Dodge] as long as they are not adjacent to at least ::value1:: enemies.

CrawlerChaosClaws.name: Chaos Claws
CrawlerChaosClaws.desc: Deals [DMG] to all units in the area and applies [IconBleeding].

CrawlerSerratedTalons.name: Serrated Talons
CrawlerSerratedTalons.desc: Deals [DMG] to all enemy units in the area, pulls them into melee range and applies [Immobile] for ::value2:: rounds.

CrawlerMassiveAttack.name: Rebuff
CrawlerMassiveAttack.desc: If the unit is attacked while [Surrounded], they retaliate, dealing [DMG] to all adjacent units and knocking them back by ::value1:: metres and apply [Immobile] to those units for 1 round.

CrawlerSurvival.name: Survive
CrawlerSurvival.desc:
If an ally is in range, this unit drains all of their [CurHP] to heal themselves.
Otherwise, calls ::value1:: creepers as back-up.

SeaStrike.name: Tactical Strike
SeaStrike.desc: Deals [DMG] to the target. The damage <good>+::value1::%</good> for each Bonus and Penalty applied to the target and this unit.

Duel.name: Duel
Duel.desc: Deals [DMG] and randomly applies one of this unit's Penalties to the target, then randomly gains one of the target's Bonuses.

Duel1.name: Duel
Duel1.desc: Deals [DMG] and randomly applies one of this unit's Penalties to the target, then randomly gains one of the target's Bonuses.

StanceDancing.name: Stance Dancing
StanceDancing.desc: Every time this unit takes damage, they gain ::value1:: [DefensiveStance] or [BerserkerStance].

CombatFlow.name: Battle Flow

ImpalingStrike.name: Crushing Blow

ThrowingAlazarianAxes.name: Alazarian Axe Throw

EuphoricAddiction.name: Euphoric Addiction

UnbreakableBond1.name: Unbreakable Bond

UnbreakableBond2.name: Unbreakable Bond
UnbreakableBond2.desc: If Ecila dies, this unit gains [Berserk].

ThrillOfTheTrack.name: Tracker's Delight

EcilaWrath.name: Ecila's Wrath

PheromoneShooting.name: Pheromone Shot

HystericalPunches.name: Hysterical Pummelling

WarmBlood.name: Hot-Blooded

Rougneck.name: Hard-Boiled

UncontrollableBackhand.name: Uncontrollable Backhand

Trueshot.name: True Shot

AlazarianMine.name: Alazarian Mine
AlazarianMine.desc: Any unit coming into contact with the mine triggers it: it deals damage [DestIcon]::value1::% to nearby units and creates a [Fire].

FranticStrike.name: Frantic Strike

UnstableLightningStrike.name: Unstable Lightning

EnlilChastising.name: Enlil's Zeal

EnlilChastising1.name: Enlil's Fervor

Deals [DMG] to the target and gains ::value1:: [Fervor].

Champion21Shot.name: Shot
Champion21Shot.desc: Deals [DMG] to the target. The damage <good>+::value1::%</good>, if the target is within ::value2:: metres.

Champion21Range.name: Braided Ritual Cord

ScaryStrike.name: Terrifying Strike

OilProcBleeding1.desc: Every time a skill deals damage, has a ::value1::% chance to apply [IconBleeding].

ProcBurning.name: On Fire!
ProcBurning.desc: When a skill deals damage in melee range, there is a ::value1::% chance to apply [IconBurning].

OilProcTrueDmg1.desc: Every time a skill deals damage, there is a ::value1::% chance to deal extra damage: [DestIcon]::value2::%.

OilStrengthProc1.desc: Every time a skill deals damage, there is a ::value1::% chance to increase [Strength] by 16% for ::value2:: rounds. Does not stack with similar effects.

ShotBeastTrap.desc: Deals [DMG] and applies [MasterTrapped] to the target.

RemoveBeastTrap.name: Remove the Trap
RemoveBeastTrap.desc: If a unit is linked to this trap, removes [MasterTrapped] from the unit, deals [DMG] and applies [IconBleeding].

RepareBeastTrap.name: Repair the Trap
RepareBeastTrap.desc: Restores the trap to working condition.

MonstrousSkin.name: Monstrous Flesh
MonstrousSkin.desc: [DamageTakenPercent] <good>-::value1::%</good>. Damage dealt to this unit cannot exceed ::maxDmgPercent::% of its [MaxHP].

WeakPoint.name: Weak Point
WeakPoint.desc: This unit avoids attacks to the head as long as it is not [BeastDestabilized].

CartFleeArea.name: Escape Area
CartFleeArea.desc: Escort the convoy to this area without letting it be destroyed.

Door_E3Burning.name: Burning Building
Door_E3Burning.desc: ::nbCivils:: civilians are trapped inside this building and will die in ::nTurns:: rounds.

Door_E3Burning_Free.name: Rescue
Door_E3Burning_Free.desc: Breaks down the door of the burning building and rescues the civilians trapped inside.

Targeting.name: Targeting
Targeting.desc: This unit is readying a skill. They cannot start any other action or become engaged in combat.

Engaged.name: Engaged
Engaged.desc: This unit can only target the engaged opponent. Chance of taking a critical hit from other units <good>+::value::%</good>(<good>+20%</good>, if attaked from behind).

OpportunityAttack.name: Attack of Opportunity
OpportunityAttack.desc: Does not engage in combat. Deals 230% of the main aptitude, [Strength] or [Dexterity].

Pushback.name: Knock Back
Pushback.desc: The target is forcibly moved backward.

ActionBase.name: Base Action
ActionBase.desc: A unit can only perform one base action or attack per turn.

Ultimate.name: Bravery
Ultimate.desc:
The Troop can perform only one Bravery skill per round.
Each Companion can use their Bravery skill only once per battle.

Gladiator.name: Gladiator
Gladiator.desc:
All attributes are increased.
Cannot be captured.

Champion.name: Elite
Champion.desc:
Can use multiple abilities in the same round.
DoT are greatly reduced and only triggered at the end of the round.
Cannot be captured.
Immune to some Penalties.

Fierce.name: Rare Species
Fierce.desc: All attributes are increased compared to other members of its species.

ImportantUnit.name: Important character
ImportantUnit.desc: This unit is an important character. If they die, you will have to restart the battle.

ScaredUnit.name: Scared
ScaredUnit.desc: This unit is scared and can only defend or flee.

Prisoner.name: Prisoner
Prisoner.desc: This unit is a prisoner. They cannot attack or move, nor obtain any Bonuses.

CaptureWanted.name: Wanted
CaptureWanted.desc: This unit is Wanted. You must capture them and deliver them to the Prison. This unit will not join your troop and has a greater chance of escaping.

CaptureWantedThief.desc: This unit is Wanted. You must capture them and deliver them to the Lair. This unit will not join your troop and has a greater chance of escaping.

Mutation.name: Mutated
Mutation.desc:
Permanent effect, stackable up to 33 times:
[Constitution] <good>+1</good>.

Betrayer.name: Traitorous
Betrayer.desc:
Permanent effect, stackable up to 33 times:
[Willpower] <good>+1</good>.

Heroic.name: Heroic
Heroic.desc:
Permanent effect, stackable up to 33 times:
[CritHitPercent] <good>+1</good>.

GrownArmor.name: Skin Scale
GrownArmor.desc:
Permanent effect, stackable up to 20 times:
[MaxAr] <good>+15</good>,
[GIcon] <good>+1%</good>.

HairGrowing.name: Hair regrowth
HairGrowing.desc: According to the label on the bottle, you need to sleep for it to take effect.

PrisonerWatched.name: Monitored
PrisonerWatched.desc: The prisoner will be unable to escape.

PreventPrisonerEscape.desc: No prisoner can escape on the next Rest.

Fury.name: Fury
Fury.desc:
The effect is removed when the unit performs any attacking action:
[DamageBonusPercent] <good>+[ATTR_0]%</good>.

Deflection.name: Deflection
Deflection.desc:
The effect is removed when the unit takes any damage:
[DamageReducePercent] <good>-[ATTR_0]%</good>.

Riposte.name: Riposte
Riposte.desc: The next time this unit is attacked by their engaged opponent, they attack in return with an attack of opportunity. Cancelled, if the unit moves.

RiposteAny.name: Retaliation
RiposteAny.desc: Each time this unit is attacked within 1m radius area, they attack in return with an attack of opportunity, if possible. Does not work against attacks of opportunity.

Vitality.name: Posture
Vitality.desc: The damage or effectiveness of an ability is calculated as a percentage of [MaxHP] of this unit.

Destruction.name: Destruction
Destruction.desc: The damage is dealt directly to [CurHP], it is calculated as a percentage of [MaxHP] of the targets.

Fief_Currency_Power.name: Power
Fief_Currency_Power.desc: Measures your authority with your people and with outsiders. Allows you to appoint a Government and use Assignments. Obtained via Governments, during Audiences and when levelling up.

Fief_Needs_Food.name: Food
Fief_Needs_Food.desc: Measures the Fief's [Fief_Needs_Food] production relative to the amount your population needs. This need increases with the number of residents, and is modified by the composition of your population. Increases [Fief_Val_Happy] when full, or decreases it otherwise.

Fief_Needs_Defense.name: Defence
Fief_Needs_Defense.desc: Measures the Fief's [Fief_Needs_Defense] production relative to the amount your population needs. This need increases with the number of residents, and is modified by the composition of your population. Increases [Fief_Val_Happy] when full, or decreases it otherwise.

Fief_Needs_Hobbies.name: Trade Goods
Fief_Needs_Hobbies.desc: Measures the Fief's [Fief_Needs_Hobbies] production relative to the amount your population needs. This need increases with the number of residents, and is modified by the composition of your population. Increases [Fief_Val_Happy] when full, or decreases it otherwise.

Fief_Needs_Education.name: Knowledge
Fief_Needs_Education.desc: Measures the Fief's [Fief_Needs_Education] production relative to the amount your population needs. This need increases with the number of residents, and is modified by the composition of your population. Increases [Fief_Val_Happy] when full, or decreases it otherwise.

Fief_Val_Happy.name: Happiness
Fief_Val_Happy.desc: At each Rest, determines the [Fief_Val_Pop] growth. The higher their happiness, the more the population will grow. If it is negative, you will lose residents.

Fief_Val_Pop.name: Population
Fief_Val_Pop.desc: Increases or decreases based on [Fief_Val_Happy]. Made up of different population types. Each one increases or reduces one or more needs. Increase the maximum population that the Fief can support by building or upgrading buildings.

AlignmentMight.names.name: Militarism
AlignmentMight.desc: Develop your Fief's military power, keep your people safe and send Troops to the Five Kingdoms.

AlignmentTrade.names.name: Trade
AlignmentTrade.desc: Become an economic power, conduct trade with the Five Kingdoms and develop business within your Fief.

AlignmentCrime.names.name: Criminality
AlignmentCrime.desc: Allow crime to proliferate in the shadows, favouring criminals over honest folk. Let corruption hold the reins of power.

AlignmentMystery.names.name: Scholarship
AlignmentMystery.desc: Train the greatest Scholars and become an essential centre of knowledge and research.

None.inf.name: No government
None.inf.desc: Your Fief has no government. Spend [Fief_Currency_Power] to choose one.

Mercenary.inf.name: In Good Company
Mercenary.inf.desc: A Fief is no more than a big company, so the Mercenaries run it by the same rules.

Democracy.inf.name: Power to the People
Democracy.inf.desc: With no king and no leader, citizens decide their future for themselves.

CrimeState.inf.name: Crime-Ridden
CrimeState.inf.desc: Bandits and crooks make the law, based on their own interests.

Corporation.inf.name: Profit is King
Corporation.inf.desc: Its subjects are employees, and their value is defined by their contribution to its profits.

MartialState.inf.name: Might Makes Right
MartialState.inf.desc: Only those who defend the Fief are qualified to rule it.

Technocracy.inf.name: Guided by Knowledge
Technocracy.inf.desc: The most educated and prestigious Scholars decide in everyone else's best interest.

TheocracyLight.inf.name: Illuminated by the Light
TheocracyLight.inf.desc: Residents faithfully follow the precepts of the Eye, and the priests guide their rulers' decisions.

TheocracyTules.inf.name: Tule Sanctuary
TheocracyTules.inf.desc: The Fief's rulers are guided by the whispers of the little gods. Woe betide those who don't follow their rituals!

Fanatic.inf.name: Triumph of Faith
Fanatic.inf.desc: Heretics must be tracked down and punished! There is only one true faith, and everything else is lies!

Kleptocracy.inf.name: Bane of the Five Kingdoms
Kleptocracy.inf.desc: Those who cannot protect their possessions deserve to be robbed.

Tyranny.inf.name: The Tyrant's Yoke
Tyranny.inf.desc: Terror is an effective way to preserve public order. Even the slightest opposition will be crushed.

Pacifism.inf.name: Safe Haven
Pacifism.inf.desc: The Fief is a refuge for those who have suffered the horrors of war for too long.

Aristocracy.inf.name: Blood Lines
Aristocracy.inf.desc: The family that a citizen is born into defines their place within the Fief. Nobles are destined to rule, and others to obey them.

PeasantGov.inf.name: Sovereign Workers
PeasantGov.inf.desc: Those who feed and enrich the Fief should also decide its future.

Fief_Event01.desc: There's been an accident: a child who was playing by the lake has drowned.

Fief_Event02.desc: Your residents are unhappy – some have even stopped working in protest.

Fief_Event03.desc: Your residents are unhappy: there have been a number of desertions from the Militia.

Fief_Event04.desc: Your residents are unhappy: your Craftsmen's workshops have been vandalised.

Fief_Event05.desc: Your residents are unhappy: the Scholars are too busy protesting to study.

Fief_Event06.desc: The Farmers are happy to be working for you, and put more heart into their daily efforts.

Fief_Event07.desc: Proud to be wearing your colours, the Militia are enthusiastic and efficient in their work.

Fief_Event08.desc: The Craftsmen are so happy to be working for you that they don't bother keeping track of their hours.

Fief_Event09.desc: Happy with their conditions, the Scholars are more ambitious than ever in their quest for Knowledge.

Fief_Event10.desc: Some residents have chosen to abandon their children in the forest rather than watch them starve to death.

Fief_Event11.desc: Wracked with hunger, some of your residents have left the Fief to try their luck elsewhere.

Fief_Event12.desc: Since no one needs to steal in order to eat, crime is down in all districts.

Fief_Event13.desc: Your residents have organised a Rouste tournament.

Fief_Event14.desc: Your residents lack all the essentials. Today a brawl broke out over a shoe.

Fief_Event15.desc: With nothing to buy, Merchants are losing interest in your Fief.

Fief_Event16.desc: Your craftsmen's excellent work has led Gosenberg Merchants to offer them contracts.

Fief_Event17.desc: Your residents blindly have spent a fortune on completely useless Hair Growth Lotions.

Fief_Event18.desc: A resident died because he couldn't tell which mushrooms were poisonous.

Fief_Event19.desc: A Scholar has discovered a highly effective remedy for frostbite.

Fief_Event20.desc: A prisoner managed to escape when his jailers' vigilance flagged.

Fief_Event21.desc: The populace is up in arms over a number of mysterious disappearances.

Fief_Event22.desc: Your Militia repelled a Bandit attack.

Fief_Event24.desc: Your Jugglers put on an exceptional performance of The Green Night of the Tules.

Fief_Event25.desc: Your Militia was able to extinguish a fire.

Fief_Event26.desc: An eminent Alazarian professor has joined your Scholars' ranks.

Fief_Event27.desc: The poet Meretha from Ormance gave a lute recital in your inn.

Fief_Event28.desc: The Jailers performed a public execution, which was a rousing success.

Fief_Event29.desc: A famous Gosenberg Merchant has declared the Caravan Travel Post to be an essential trading hub.

Fief_Event30.desc: Your Apothecary prevented an epidemic from spreading.

Fief_Event31.desc: Your residents have got in the habit of going to look at the animals in the stables for entertainment.

Fief_Event32.desc: Your Farmers organised a sheep fair.

Fief_Event33.desc: Your residents organised a banquet in honour of young newlyweds.

Fief_Event34.desc: Thanks to the gambling den, the Outlaws have come to an agreement, and murders between rival gangs have stopped.

Fief_Event35.desc: The Black Market is said to have robbed the honest merchants blind.

Fief_Event36.desc: A brawl broke out over a game and the gambling den was set ablaze.

Fief_Event37.desc: A famous stone sculptor has decided to join your workshop.

Fief_Event38.desc: Now that an embassy has been built in your Fief, the neighbouring kingdoms have more respect for you.

Fief_Event39.desc: An altercation broke out between the Alazarian and Gosenberg delegations on their way out of the Embassy. Your residents were highly entertained.

Fief_Event40.desc: A fire broke out in your new district, damaging houses and businesses.

Fief_Event41.desc: A foul odour is spreading within the Fief.

Fief_Audience06Event01.desc: Someone set fire to the Fief's granaries. Could it be the shadowy figure that the Militia had spotted?

Fief_Audience06Event02.desc: The mysterious shadowy figure that was prowling around near the granary seems to have disappeared.

Fief_Audience09Event01.desc: The man who poisoned the well was unmasked and promptly hanged.

Fief_Audience09Event02.desc: The man who poisoned the well was never found...

Fief_Audience09Event03.desc: Your wells have been poisoned again. Multiple residents have died in terrible agony.

Fief_Audience10Event01.desc: Your mercenaries found the bandits and rescued your residents.

Fief_Audience10Event02.desc: The Bandits sent the missing residents' heads back to your Fief.

Fief_Audience19Event01.desc: You kept your promise and made your Fief a democracy.

Fief_Audience19Event02.desc: You failed to keep your promise, and your people are losing trust in you.

Fief_Audience20Event01.desc: You've managed to stabilise the Fief's finances. The Merchants are satisfied with your efforts.

Fief_Audience20Event02.desc: You failed to improve your finances, leading multiple Merchants to leave your Fief.

Fief_Audience21Event01.desc: Your Militia successfully countered an attack by a gang of Bandits who wanted to take over your Fief.

Fief_Audience21Event02.desc: A gang of Bandits attacked your kingdom. Although your Militia were able to repel them, they inflicted serious damage.

Fief_Audience22Event01.desc: Sewer construction work revealed a treasure buried under your Fief.

Fief_Audience22Event02.desc: Thanks to your stock of remedies, the pestilence emanating from your streets didn't make anyone sick.

Fief_Audience22Event03.desc: The pestilence emanating from your streets made a number of residents sick, leaving them unable to work.

Fief_Audience23Event01.desc: The Festival of Light went off without a hitch.

Fief_Audience23Event02.desc: The Eye's Reckoning struck your Fief.

Fief_Audience24Event01.desc: Your Mercenaries eliminated the Ghost Pack that was threatening your subjects.

Fief_Audience24Event02.desc: The Ghost Pack attacked and killed a farmer.

Fief_Audience24Event03.desc: The Trackers were ultimately able to defeat the Ghost Pack without your help.

Fief_Audience25Event01.desc: Your Mercenaries destroyed the Rats' Nest that was threatening their Fief.

Fief_Audience25Event02.desc: The first cases of the Plague have been recorded in your Fief.

Fief_Audience25BisEvent01.desc: The measures taken to contain the Plague worked: no one else has fallen ill.

Fief_Audience25BisEvent02.desc: The measures taken to contain the Plague worked: the sick residents have recovered.

Fief_Audience25BisEvent03.desc: The Plague spread in your Fief and killed a number of residents before disappearing on its own.

Fief_Audience25BisEvent03_2.desc: The Plague spread in your Fief and killed a number of residents before disappearing on its own.

Fief_Audience26Event01.desc: Your Mercenaries found the culprits behind the caravan's disappearance and recovered its cargo.

Fief_Audience26Event02.desc: The caravan disappeared too long ago and there's no longer any chance of finding its cargo.

Fief_Audience27Event01.desc: Several of your residents are suffering from a terrible stomach bug. The Militia's report shows that they all ate at the same Tavern the night before.

Fief_Audience29Event01.desc: Your Mercenaries won the fishing contest, drawing admiration from the fishermen.

Fief_Audience29Event02.desc: You broke your promise, and the fishermen are bitterly disappointed.

Fief_Audience30Event01.desc: Several of your residents were summarily hung. Terrorised, the populace no longer dares to complain.

Fief_Audience30Event02.desc: Several of your residents were summarily hung. Mad with rage, the populace attacked the militia.

Fief_Audience30Event03.desc: After a lengthy investigation, your Militia has unmasked and hung the leaders of the revolt. Calm has been restored for the moment.

Fief_Audience30Event04.desc: Despite a lengthy investigation, the leaders of the revolt have slipped through your Militia's fingers.

Fief_Audience31Event01.desc: Thanks to your generous donations, the sheep festival was a success.

Fief_Audience31Event02.desc: You broke your promise, and the sheep festival was ruined.

Fief_Audience34Event01.desc: Two Farmers who had cut down a tree the day before woke up with their hands covered in pustules.

Fief_Audience34Event01_2.desc: Two Farmers who had cut down a tree the day before woke up with their hands covered in pustules.

Fief_Audience34Event02.desc: The Tules have given no sign of their presence, so your workers can cut wood without fear.

Fief_Audience34Event03.desc: Now that the rituals to appease the Tules have been completed, work can continue.

Fief_Audience36Event01.desc: The faithful are thrilled that a church has been built in your Fief.

Fief_Audience37Event01.desc: After construction was halted, your Scholars discovered a number of artefacts that they sent to your Troop.

Fief_Audience37Event02.desc: What was supposed to be an Ancient city turned out to be a smugglers' cache. Even so, it did contain one interesting artefact.

Fief_Audience37Event03.desc: Besides preventing a proper dig, resuming construction was seen by your Scholars as a rank betrayal.

Fief_Audience40Event01.desc: The Edoranian General greatly appreciated his gift.

Fief_Audience40Event02.desc: In appearing before the General without a gift, your ambassador made herself the laughingstock of Edoran.

Fief_Audience41Event01.desc: The clans of Harag are deeply grateful for the help you provided to their sick brethren.

Fief_Audience41Event02.desc: The clans of Harag are not surprised that you broke your promise, but they're disappointed nonetheless.

Fief_Audience42Event01.desc: The King of Alazar was greatly impressed with the breadth of your Scholars' Knowledge.

Fief_Audience42Event02.desc: The King of Alazar was highly amused by your ridiculous attempt to impress him.

Fief_Audience43Event01.desc: Thanks to your help, the Arena Clash was the most festive in years. The Broker Council is most grateful.

Fief_Audience43Event02.desc: Grinmeer's latest Arena Clash was unbelievably dull. The Broker Council holds you personally responsible.

Fief_Audience44Event01.desc: After your Mercenaries' intervention, the Smugglers won't be causing trouble any time soon.

Fief_Audience44Event02.desc: You lost all trace of the Smugglers.

Fief_Audience59Event01.desc: Your militia were able to track down the thieves. The Gosenberg Merchant is already singing your praises.

Fief_Audience59Event02.desc: With no witnesses, your Militia were unable to find the thieves who robbed the Gosenberg Merchant.

Fief_Mandate_LocateSepulcre.desc: The Sepulchre's location will be shown on the map.

- Class
- Level
- Attributes
- Skills

Mission_AddRelation_Hard.text.title: Protect an important individual from [::kingdomKind::]
Mission_AddRelation_Hard.text.desc: An important person from [::kingdomKind::] has already been the target of a failed assassination attempt. Their entourage is offering a handsome reward to whoever can protect them from their would-be killers.

Mission_RemoveRelation_Hard.text.title: Plunder a village in [::kingdomKind::]
Mission_RemoveRelation_Hard.text.desc: The harvest season is at its peak in [::kingdomKind::]. It's the perfect time to plunder their villages!

Mission_RemoveRelation_Medium.text.title: Attack a [::kingdomKind::] Border Crossing
Mission_RemoveRelation_Medium.text.desc: The [::kingdomKind::] Guard is being a bit overzealous about inspecting goods that cross over its borders. The local Bandits would like to see things loosen up a bit.

Mission_AddRelation_Medium.text.title: Destroy a Bandit Camp in [::kingdomKind::]
Mission_AddRelation_Medium.text.desc: A Bandit Camp is disrupting residents' lives in [::kingdomKind::]. Local authorities are offering a bounty for destroying it.

Mission_AddRelation_Easy.text.title: Escort a Caravan from [::kingdomKind::]
Mission_AddRelation_Easy.text.desc: A Caravan from [::kingdomKind::] is looking for Mercenaries to protect it during its perilous voyage.

Mission_RemoveRelation_Easy.text.title: Attack a Caravan from [::kingdomKind::]
Mission_RemoveRelation_Easy.text.desc: A Caravan from [::kingdomKind::] has the audacity to travel without an escort. Robbing it should be a breeze.

MissionAudience_10.text.title: Rescue
MissionAudience_10.text.desc: Some residents of the Fief have disappeared! Find them and punish their captors.

MissionAudience_24.text.title: Kill
MissionAudience_24.text.desc: A Ghost Pack is haunting Mount Altis and threatening your residents.

MissionAudience_25.text.title: Exterminate
MissionAudience_25.text.desc: It's only a question of time before the Mount Altis Rat Infestation spreads the Plague to your Fief.

MissionAudience_26.text.title: Recover
MissionAudience_26.text.desc: Send your Mercenaries to inspect the place where a caravan disappeared and recover its cargo.

MissionAudience_29.text.title: Participate
MissionAudience_29.text.desc: You promised that you would take part in the fishing competition, and your residents are counting on you to be there.

MissionAudience_44.text.title: Vanquish
MissionAudience_44.text.desc: Some Smugglers are shamelessly enriching themselves on your backs. They need to be taught a lesson.

Tax.title: Tax the People
Tax.desc:
<comment>Start:</comment> Generates [Fief_Currency_Money].
<comment>At each Rest:</comment> Applies a [Fief_Val_Happy] penalty.

EducatePop.title: Educate a Population
EducatePop.desc: <comment>At each Rest:</comment> A selected population type produces [Fief_Needs_Education].

Prospection.title: Prospect a Population
Prospection.desc: <comment>Start:</comment> Increases a selected population type's numbers.

RemovePopulation.title: Expel a population group
RemovePopulation.desc: <comment>Start:</comment> Reduces a selected population type's numbers.

Blackmarket.title: Export Contraband
Blackmarket.desc:
<comment>Start:</comment> Damages the relationship with a selected kingdom.
<comment>At each Rest:</comment> Increases production of items from that kingdom.

Stable.title: Stable Visits
Stable.desc: <comment>At each Rest:</comment> Increases production of [Fief_Needs_Hobbies] for each animal in [FiefPlace_Stable].

BanditHideout.title: Rob
BanditHideout.desc: <comment>Start:</comment> Increases the [Bandit] population and generates [Fief_Currency_Money] for each dwelling in the Fief.

Embassy.title: Diplomatic Visit
Embassy.desc: <comment>Start:</comment> Improves the relationship with the selected kingdom.

Blacksmith.title: Arm the Militia
Blacksmith.desc: Start: Increases the Militiamen population. At each Rest: Reduces the Militia District's production of [Fief_Needs_Defense] and each Militiaman produces [Fief_Needs_Defense].

Farm.title: Seasonal Hire
Farm.desc: <comment>At each Rest:</comment> A selected [Cook] Companion produces [Fief_Needs_Food].

GamblingDen.title: Tax on Gambling
GamblingDen.desc: <comment>At each Rest:</comment> Generates as much [Fief_Currency_Money] as the [Fief_Needs_Hobbies] production.

Execution.title: Public Execution
Execution.desc:
<comment>Start:</comment> Executes a selected prisoner, which greatly reduces [Fief_Val_Happy].
<comment>At each Rest:</comment> Grants a production bonus on [Fief_Needs_Defense] and [Fief_Needs_Hobbies].

PrisonWork.title: Forced Labour
PrisonWork.desc: <comment>At each Rest:</comment> Prisoners produce a small amount of each need.

Celebration.title: Organise a festival
Celebration.desc: All needs are satisfied during the Assignment.

CelebrationLight.title: Festival of Light
CelebrationLight.desc:
All needs are satisfied during the Assignment.
<comment>Start:</comment> Each [Cleric] in the population produces [Fief_Currency_Power].

CheapServices.title: Rule of Law
CheapServices.desc: The cost of the Fief's services is reduced during the Assignment.

Fines.title: Heavy Fines
Fines.desc:
<comment>At each Rest:</comment> Generates [Fief_Currency_Money] for each [Bandit] in the population.
<comment>End:</comment>Reduces the [Bandit] population.

Proselyte.title: Conversion
Proselyte.desc:
<comment>Start:</comment> Increases the [Cleric] population.
<comment>At each Rest:</comment> Each [Cleric] produces [Fief_Needs_Hobbies].

ReinforceMilitiaMultiple.title: Support the Militia
ReinforceMilitiaMultiple.desc: <comment>At each Rest:</comment> The selected Companions in the garrison produce [Fief_Needs_Defense].

ReinforceMilitiaSingle.title: Support the Militia
ReinforceMilitiaSingle.desc: <comment>At each Rest:</comment> The selected Companion in the garrison produces [Fief_Needs_Defense].

Disarm.title: Disarm the Fief
Disarm.desc: Start: Improves relations with all kingdoms. Reduces the [Bandit] and Militiamen population. Generates [Fief_Currency_Power] for each resident.

ShareRiches.title: Redistribution of Wealth
ShareRiches.desc: <comment>At each Rest:</comment> The Fief’s total production is distributed equally among all needs.

RepressOpposition.title: Suppress Opposition
RepressOpposition.desc:
<comment>Start:</comment> Slightly reduces [Fief_Val_Pop].
All needs are reduced during the Assignment.

Corruption.title: Collect Bribes
Corruption.desc:
<comment>At each Rest:</comment> Generates [Fief_Currency_Money] for each [Bandit] in the population.
Reduces [Fief_Needs_Defense] during the Assignment.

Conference.title: Organise a Conference
Conference.desc:
<comment>At each Rest:</comment> Each production of [Fief_Needs_Education] generates [Fief_Currency_Money].
The [Fief_Needs_Education] need is satisfied during the Assignment.

ProselyteForce.title: Forced Conversion
ProselyteForce.desc:
<comment>Start:</comment> Increases the [Cleric] population immediately
<comment>At each Rest:</comment> Increases production of [Fief_Needs_Defense].

Raid.title: Launch a Raid
Raid.desc: Start: Damages the relationship with the selected kingdom. Reduces the Militiamen population. Generates [Fief_Currency_Power] and [Fief_Currency_Money].

ChooseMonarch.title: Appoint a Monarch
ChooseMonarch.desc:
The selected Mercenary becomes a monarch.
When the monarch is in the Fief, needs are reduced. When they are in the Troop, generates [Fief_Currency_Power] at each Rest.

TeachTrait.title: Teach a Trait
TeachTrait.desc: Gives a positive trait to a Companion.

LocateSepulcre.title: Locate a sepulchre
LocateSepulcre.desc: Shows the location of the Sepulchre associated with the selected codices.

TrainUnit.title: Train a Companion
TrainUnit.desc: Increases a Companion's level to match the Troop's level.

TrainAnimal.title: Train an Animal
TrainAnimal.desc: Increases an animal's level to match the Troop's level.

MakeRecruit.title: Train a Recruit
MakeRecruit.desc: Trains a new recruit to have similar attributes to the selected Companion, and sends them to the [FiefPlace_Auberge].

RepentanceLight.title: Repent
RepentanceLight.desc: Removes a negative trait from a Companion.

RepentanceTules.title: Repent
RepentanceTules.desc: Removes a negative trait from a Companion.

Rehabilitate.title: Rehabilitate
Rehabilitate.desc: Releases the selected prisoner and sends them to the [FiefPlace_Auberge]. They can then be recruited.

KidnapSpecific.title: Kidnap
KidnapSpecific.desc: Add someone from a selected faction to the Fief's prisoners.

BuyAnimal.title: Buy an Animal
BuyAnimal.desc: Adds an animal of a species you already own to the [FiefPlace_Stable].

PathLevelUp.desc: Gain a level on one of the Paths

line0.text: [XX] Once we're famous, everyone will want to hire us!
[XX] What if someone grabs the treasures of the Ancients before us?
[XX] All I want is a good bed... maybe even clean sheets, if I'm lucky!
[XX] I can't wait to get there and show the others how much I've changed!
[XX] It's about time I showed nature who's in charge!
[XX] Animals are a gift from nature. They belong at our side.
[XX] My fists are itching.

KillUnit.desc: Kill a unit during a fight.

line0.text: [XX] So when do we fight? I need to do some killing, quick!

SendToPrison.desc: Deliver a prisoner to a jail

line0.text: [XX] These bandits... They deserve what's coming to them.
[XX] All that money just rattling around in the back of those little carriages...
[XX] I love fighting, and I want to prove to myself that I'm good at it!

WinFightGhostPack.desc: Win a fight against the Ghost Pack

line0.text: [XX] Delaying the inevitable isn't a real solution.
[XX] I can already hear the crowd calling my name!

DoSport.desc: Take part in a Rouste match

line0.text: [XX] I hope our team wins!
[XX] I wonder what our next recruit will be capable of.

line0.desc: ::reward.relation[0].v(s):: Relationship with the recruited Companion

RecruitPrisoner.desc: Recruit a new Companion in a jail

line0.text: [XX] Everyone deserves a chance at redemption.

line0.desc: ::reward.relation[0].v(s):: Relationship with the recruited Companion

line0.text: [XM] We've got to keep an eye on him – he could run off at any moment...

line1.text: [XF] We've got to keep an eye on her – she could run off at any moment...

SellUnproducedTradeGoods.desc: Sell goods to a city that doesn't have them

line0.text: [XX] I can't stand the sight of these old crates any more. Time to turn them into gold.
[XX] We need to get rid of this old junk... I mean, we need to find a new owner for our charming trinkets.
[XX] A good craftsman stands out for his talent AND his tools.
[XX] Once I've laundered all these stolen items, we can sell them to anyone we like and make a small fortune.
[XX] Without these materials, we might as well be wearing rags into battle.
[XX] We need to get healing remedies as quickly as possible.
[XX] Go and see the Trackers as soon as possible.

line0.desc: The prices of your next ::reward.item[0].count:: purchases from the Trackers' Guild will be reduced.

line0.text: [XX] I hope ::validateCond[0].ctx[1].target:: and I can become friends...
[XX] Here's hoping our spirits stay high, despite all the challenges.

NoDeath.desc: No human deaths in the troop

line0.text: [XX] As long as I'm here, no one dies, understood?
[XX] I can't wait to get back to work.
[XX] I hope we're able to find the team member we need.
[XX] I can't wait to set down this load – I can't go on much longer.

line0.desc: The new pony will gain the ::reward.traits[0].trait:: trait.

AlcoholicRest.desc: Make a recipe consisting entirely of alcohol

line0.text: [XX] I'll stop after this, I promise!
[XX] I know it's bad for me, but it's so good...
[XX] I hope I start seeing some real progress...
[XX] The secrets of the Ancients are just a few translations away!
[XX] The gentle splash of the waves, the quiet waiting, the peaceful calm of nature... I'm really looking forward to it.
[XX] It's important to always have a bit of iron on hand. You can do just about anything with it.
[XX] Cutting wood's a simple task, but it's a nice distraction.

DefeatHunted.desc: Defeat a group of tracked animals

line0.text: [XX] The hunt won't wait!

LockpickChest.desc: Pick the lock on a chest and steal what's inside

line0.text: [XX] Locks are nothing but a pleasant challenge for me.
[XX] The forge is calling me.
[XX] I want to cook – to let the ingredients speak, to listen to their stories and hear them sing...

TrainingDummy.desc: Train for ::validateCond[0].val:: Rests on the training dummy.

line0.text: [XX] Training between fights is just as important as the fights themselves.
[XX] I can't wait to taste what this region has to offer.
